x: Shaykh Muḥyī al-Dīn ʿAbd al-Qādir al-Jīlānī qaddasa’llāhu sirrahu
Also named al-Yāqūt al-Ḥamrāʾ wa’l-Durrat al-Khaḍrāʾ — the Red Ruby and the Green Pearl. It is recited in seven daily portions, Friday through Thursday.
Friday وِرْدُ يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ

بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيْمِ ﴿ لَقَدْ جَآءَكُمْ رَسُوْلٌ مِّنْ أَنْفُسِكُمْ عَزِيْزٌ عَلَيْهِ مَا عَنِتُّمْ حَرِيْصٌ عَلَيْكُمْ بِالْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ رَؤُوْفٌ رَّحِيْمٌ ۝ ﴾ أَعْبُدُ اللهَ رَبِّـيْ وَلَاۤ اُشْرِكُ بِهٖ شَيْئًا ۝
Bismi llāhi r-Raḥmāni r-Raḥīm. ⟨ Laqad jāʾakum rasūlun min anfusikum ʿazīzun ʿalayhi mā ʿanittum ḥarīṣun ʿalaykum bi-l-muʾminīna raʾūfun raḥīm. ⟩ Aʿbudu llāha rabbī wa lā ushriku bihi shayʾā.

In the name of Allāh, the All-Merciful, the Ever-Merciful. ⟨ There has come to you a Messenger from among yourselves; grievous to him is your suffering, ever solicitous for you, and to the believers kind and merciful. ⟩ I worship Allāh my Lord, and I associate nothing with Him.

اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّـيْ أَدْعُوْكَ بِأَسْمَاۤئِكَ الْحُسْنٰى كُلِّهَا، لَاۤ إِلٰهَ إِلَّاۤ أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ، أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَّعَلَىٰ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَىٰ إِبْرَاهِيْمَ وَعَلَىٰ آلِ إِبْرَاهِيْمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيْدٌ مَّجِيْدٌ ۝

Allāhumma innī adʿūka bi-asmāʾika l-ḥusnā kullihā — lā ilāha illā anta subḥānak — an tuṣalliya ʿalā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli Muḥammadin kamā ṣallayta ʿalā Ibrāhīma wa ʿalā āli Ibrāhīm; innaka Ḥamīdun Majīd.

O Allāh, I call upon You by all Your most beautiful Names — there is no god but You, glory be to You — that You bless Muḥammad and the family of Muḥammad as You blessed Ibrāhīm and the family of Ibrāhīm; truly You are Praiseworthy, Glorious.
اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدِ النَّبِيِّ الْأُمِّيِّ وَعَلَىٰ آلِهٖ وَصَحْبِهٖ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيْمًا وَّصَلَّى اللهُ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَّعَلَىٰ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَاةً هُوَ أَهْلُهَا ۝
Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammadin an-nabiyyi l-ummiyyi wa ʿalā ālihi wa ṣaḥbihi wa sallim taslīmā. Wa ṣallā llāhu ʿalā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli Muḥammadin ṣalātan huwa ahluhā.

O Allāh, bless Muḥammad the unlettered Prophet, and his family and his Companions, and grant them abundant peace. And may Allāh bless Muḥammad and the family of Muḥammad with a blessing of which he is worthy.
اَللّٰهُمَّ يَا رَبَّ مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَّعَلَىٰ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَّاجْزِ مُحَمَّدًا مَّا هُوَ أَهْلُهٗ ۝
Allāhumma yā Rabba Muḥammadin wa āli Muḥammad, ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli Muḥammad, wa-jzi Muḥammadan mā huwa ahluh.
O Allāh, O Lord of Muḥammad and the family of Muḥammad: bless Muḥammad and the family of Muḥammad, and requite Muḥammad with what he is worthy of.
اَللّٰهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمٰوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيْمِ۝
Allāhumma Rabba s-samāwāti s-sabʿi wa Rabba l-ʿarshi l-ʿaẓīm
O Allāh, Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the Mighty Throne
رَبَّنَا وَرَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَّمُنَزِّلَ التَّوْرَاةِ وَالْإِنْجِيْلِ وَالزَّبُوْرِ وَالْفُرْقَانِ الْعَظِيْمِ۝
Rabbanā wa Rabba kulli shayʾin wa munazzila t-Tawrāti wa l-Injīli wa z-Zabūri wa l-Furqāni l-ʿaẓīm
our Lord and Lord of all things, who sent down the Torah, the Gospel, the Psalms and the mighty Criterion
اَللّٰهُمَّ أَنْتَ الْأَوَّلُ فَلَيْسَ قَبْلَكَ شَيْءٌ وَّأَنْتَ الْآخِرُ فَلَيْسَ بَعْدَكَ شَيْءٌ وَّأَنْتَ الظَّاهِرُ فَلَيْسَ فَوْقَكَ شَيْءٌ وَّأَنْتَ الْبَاطِنُ فَلَيْسَ دُوْنَكَ شَيْءٌ ۝
Allāhumma anta l-Awwalu fa-laysa qablaka shayʾ, wa anta l-Ākhiru fa-laysa baʿdaka shayʾ, wa anta ẓ-Ẓāhiru fa-laysa fawqaka shayʾ, wa anta l-Bāṭinu fa-laysa dūnaka shayʾ.

O Allāh, You are the First, so there is nothing before You; and You are the Last, so there is nothing after You; and You are the Outward, so there is nothing above You; and You are the Inward, so there is nothing below You.
فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ ﴿ لَاۤ إِلٰهَ إِلَّاۤ أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَۖ إِنِّـيْ كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِيْنَ۝ ﴾ مَا شَآءَ اللهُ كَانَ وَمَالَمْ يَشَأْ لَمْ يَكُنْ، لَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللهِ ۝
Fa-laka l-ḥamd. ⟨ Lā ilāha illā anta subḥānaka innī kuntu mina ẓ-ẓālimīn. ⟩ Mā shāʾa llāhu kāna wa mā lam yashaʾ lam yakun; lā quwwata illā bi-llāh.

So Yours is the praise. ⟨ There is no god but You; glory be to You, I was among the wrongdoers. ⟩ What Allāh wills comes to be, and what He does not will does not come to be; there is no strength save by Allāh.
اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَنَبِيِّكَ وَرَسُوْلِكَ صَلَاةً مُّبَارَكَةً طَيِّبَةً كَمَا أَمَرْتَنَا أَنْ نُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيْمًا ۝
Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammadin ʿabdika wa nabiyyika wa rasūlika ṣalātan mubārakatan ṭayyibatan kamā amartanā an nuṣalliya ʿalayhi wa sallim taslīmā.
O Allāh, bless Muḥammad — Your servant, Your prophet and Your messenger — with a blessed and goodly blessing, as You commanded us to bless him, and grant him abundant peace.

اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ حَتّٰى لَا يَبْقٰى مِنْ صَلَاتِكَ شَيْءٌ، وَارْحَمْ مُحَمَّدًا حَتّٰى لَا يَبْقٰى مِنْ رَّحْمَتِكَ شَيْءٌ، وَبَارِكْ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ حَتّٰى لَا يَبْقٰى مِنْۢ بَرَكَاتِكَ شَيْءٌ ۝
Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammadin ḥattā lā yabqā min ṣalātika shayʾ; wa-rḥam Muḥammadan ḥattā lā yabqā min raḥmatika shayʾ; wa bārik ʿalā Muḥammadin ḥattā lā yabqā min barakātika shayʾ.
O Allāh, bless Muḥammad until nothing of Your blessing remains; and have mercy on Muḥammad until nothing of Your mercy remains; and grant grace to Muḥammad until nothing of Your graces remains.

اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَأَفْلِحْ وَأَنْجِحْ وَأَتْمِمْ وَأَصْلِحْ وَأَرْبِحْ وَأَوْفِ وَأَرْجِحْ أَفْضَلَ الصَّلَاةِ وَأَجْزَلَ الْمِنَنِ وَالتَّحِيَّاتِ عَلَىٰ عَبْدِكَ وَنَبِيِّكَ وَرَسُوْلِكَ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدِ الَّذِيْ هُوَ فَلَقُ صُبْحِ أَنْوَارِ الْوَحْدَانِيَّةِ وَطَلْعَةُ شَمْسِ الْأَسْرَارِ الرَّبَّانِيّةِ ۝

Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa afliḥ wa anjiḥ wa atmim wa aṣliḥ wa arbiḥ wa awfi wa arjiḥ afḍala ṣ-ṣalāti wa ajzala l-minani wa t-taḥiyyāti ʿalā ʿabdika wa nabiyyika wa rasūlika sayyidinā Muḥammad — alladhī huwa falaqu ṣubḥi anwāri l-waḥdāniyya, wa ṭalʿatu shamsi l-asrāri r-rabbāniyya

O Allāh, bless and grant peace, and give success, prospering, completion, rightness, gain, fulfilment and preponderance — the most excellent of blessings and the most abundant of favours and salutations — upon Your servant, Your prophet and Your messenger, our master Muḥammad: he who is the breaking dawn of the lights of divine oneness, and the rising of the sun of the Lordly secrets
وَبَهْجَةُ قَمَرِ الْحَقَائِقِ الصَّمَدَانِيَّةِ ۝
wa bahjatu qamari l-ḥaqāʾiqi ṣ-ṣamadāniyya
and the splendour of the moon of the realities of the Eternally Besought
وَعَرْشُ حَضْرَةِ الْحَضَرَاتِ الرَّحْمَانِيَّةِ ۝
wa ʿarshu ḥaḍrati l-ḥaḍarāti r-raḥmāniyya
and the throne of the Presence of the Merciful Presences
نُوْرُ كُلِّ رَسُوْلٍ وَّسَنَاهُ ۝
nūru kulli rasūlin wa sanāh
the light of every messenger and his radiance
﴿ يٰسٓ ۝ وَالْقُرْآنِ الْحَكِيْمِ۝ إِنَّكَ لَمِنَ الْمُرْسَلِيْنَ ۝ عَلَىٰ صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيْمٍ۝ ﴾ سِرُّ كُلِّ نَبِيٍّ وَّهُدَاهُ ۝
⟨ Yā Sīn. Wa l-Qurʾāni l-ḥakīm. Innaka la-mina l-mursalīn. ʿAlā ṣirāṭin mustaqīm. ⟩ Sirru kulli nabiyyin wa hudāh.
⟨ Yā Sīn. By the wise Qurʾān. Truly you are among the messengers, upon a straight path. ⟩ The secret of every prophet and his guidance.
﴿ ذٰلِكَ تَقْدِيْرُ الْعَزِيْزِ الْعَلِيْمِ۝ ﴾ وَجَوْهَرُ كُلِّ وَلِيٍّ وَّضِيَاهُ ۝
⟨ Dhālika taqdīru l-ʿAzīzi l-ʿAlīm. ⟩ Wa jawharu kulli waliyyin wa ḍiyāh.
⟨ That is the determining of the Mighty, the All-Knowing. ⟩ And the substance of every friend of God and his radiance.

﴿ سَلَامٌ قَوْلًا مِّنْ رَّبٍّ رَّحِيْمٍ ۝ ﴾ اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدِ النَّبِيِّ الْأُمِّيِّ الْعَرَبِيِّ الْقُرَشِيِّ الْهَاشِمِيِّ الْأَبْطَحِيِّ التُّهَامِيِّ الْمَكِّيِّ صَاحِبِ التَّاجِ وَالْكَرَامَةِ ۝
⟨ Salāmun qawlan min Rabbin Raḥīm. ⟩ Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim ʿalā Muḥammadin an-nabiyyi l-ummiyyi l-ʿarabiyyi l-Qurashiyyi l-Hāshimiyyi l-Abṭaḥiyyi t-Tuhāmiyyi l-Makkiyy — ṣāḥibi t-tāji wa l-karāma

⟨ “Peace” — a word from a Merciful Lord. ⟩ O Allāh, bless and grant peace to Muḥammad, the unlettered Prophet, the Arab, the Qurashī, the Hāshimī, of al-Abṭaḥ, of Tihāma, the Makkan — possessor of the crown and of honour
صَاحِبِ الْخَيْرِ وَالْبِرِّ ۝
ṣāḥibi l-khayri wa l-birr
possessor of goodness and piety
صَاحِبِ السَّرَايَا وَالْعَطَايَا وَالْغَزْوِ وَالْجِهَادِ وَالْمَغْنَمِ وَالْمُقْسَمِ ۝
ṣāḥibi s-sarāyā wa l-ʿaṭāyā wa l-ghazwi wa l-jihādi wa l-maghnami wa l-muqsam
possessor of the expeditions and the gifts, of the campaign and the struggle, of the spoils and their apportioning
صَاحِبِ الْآيَاتِ وَالْمُعْجِزَاتِ وَالْعَلَامَاتِ الْبَاهِرَاتِ ۝
ṣāḥibi l-āyāti wa l-muʿjizāti wa l-ʿalāmāti l-bāhirāt
possessor of the signs, the miracles and the dazzling marks
صَاحِبِ الْحَجِّ وَالْحَقِّ وَالتَّلْبِيَةِ ۝
ṣāḥibi l-ḥajji wa l-ḥaqqi wa t-talbiya
possessor of the pilgrimage, of the truth and of the talbiya
صَاحِبِ الصَّفَا والْمَرْوَةِ وَالْمِشْعَرِ الْحَرَامِ وَالْمَقَامِ وَالْقِبْلَةِ وَالْمِحْرَابِ وَالْمِنْۢبَرِ۝
ṣāḥibi ṣ-Ṣafā wa l-Marwati wa l-Mashʿari l-Ḥarāmi wa l-Maqāmi wa l-qiblati wa l-miḥrābi wa l-minbar
possessor of Ṣafā and Marwa, of the Sacred Monument, of the Station, of the qibla, of the prayer-niche and of the pulpit
صَاحِبِ الْمَقَامِ الْمَحْمُوْدِ وَالْحَوْضِ الْمَوْرُوْدِ وَالشَّفَاعَةِ وَالسُّجُوْدِ لِلرَّبِّ الْمَعْبُوْدِ ۝
ṣāḥibi l-maqāmi l-maḥmūdi wa l-ḥawḍi l-mawrūdi wa sh-shafāʿati wa s-sujūdi li-r-Rabbi l-maʿbūd
possessor of the Praiseworthy Station, of the Basin to which they come, of the intercession and of prostration before the Lord who is worshipped
صَاحِبِ رَمْيِ الْجَمَرَاتِ وَالْوُقُوْفِ بِعَرَفَاتٍ ۝
ṣāḥibi ramyi l-jamarāti wa l-wuqūfi bi-ʿArafāt
possessor of the casting of the pebbles and the standing at ʿArafāt
صَاحِبِ الْعِلْمِ الطَّوِيْلِ وَالْكَلَامِ الْجَلِيْلِ ۝
ṣāḥibi l-ʿilmi ṭ-ṭawīli wa l-kalāmi l-jalīl
possessor of far-reaching knowledge and sublime speech
صَاحِبِ كَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلَاصِ وَالصِّدْقِ وَالتَّصْدِيْقِ ۝
ṣāḥibi kalimati l-ikhlāṣi wa ṣ-ṣidqi wa t-taṣdīq
possessor of the word of sincerity, of truthfulness and of affirmation

اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَىٰ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَّعَلَىٰ آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَاةً تُنَجِّيْنَا بِهَا مِنْ جَمِيْعِ الْمِحَنِ وَالْإِحَنِ وَالْأَهْوَالِ وَالْبَلِيَّاتِ وَتُسَلِّمُنَا بِهَا مِنْ جَمِيْعِ الْفِتَنِ وَالْأَسْقَامِ وَالْآفَاتِ وَالْعَاهَاتِ۝

Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣalātan tunajjīnā bihā min jamīʿi l-miḥani wa l-iḥani wa l-ahwāli wa l-baliyyāt, wa tusallimunā bihā min jamīʿi l-fitani wa l-asqāmi wa l-āfāti wa l-ʿāhāt

O Allāh, bless and grant peace to our master Muḥammad and to the family of our master Muḥammad — a blessing by which You deliver us from every trial and rancour, from terrors and afflictions, and by which You keep us safe from every discord, sickness, blight and infirmity
وَتُطَهِّرُنَا بِهَا مِنْ جَمِيْعِ الْعُيُوْبِ وَالسَّيِّئَاتِ ۝
wa tuṭahhirunā bihā min jamīʿi l-ʿuyūbi wa s-sayyiʾāt
and by which You purify us of every fault and evil deed
وَتَغْفِرُ لَنَا بِهَا جَمِيْعَ الذُّنُوْبَاتِ ۝
wa taghfiru lanā bihā jamīʿa dh-dhunūbāt
and by which You forgive us all our sins
وَتَمْحُوْ بِهَا عَنَّا جَمِيْعَ الْخَطِيْئَاتِ ۝
wa tamḥū bihā ʿannā jamīʿa l-khaṭīʾāt
and by which You efface from us all our faults
وَتَقْضِيْ لَنَا بِهَا جَمِيْعَ مَا نَطْلُبُهٗ مِنَ الْحَاجَاتِ ۝
wa taqḍī lanā bihā jamīʿa mā naṭlubuhu mina l-ḥājāt
and by which You settle for us every need we seek
وَتَرْفَعُنَا بِهَا عِنْدَكَ أَعْلَى الدَّرَجَاتِ ۝
wa tarfaʿunā bihā ʿindaka aʿlā d-darajāt
and by which You raise us with You to the highest degrees
وَتُبَلِّغُنَا بِهَا أَقْصَى الْغَايَاتِ مِنْ جَمِيْعِ الْخَيْرَاتِ فِـي الْحَيَاةِ وَبَعْدَ الْمَمَاتِ ۝
wa tuballighunā bihā aqṣā l-ghāyāti min jamīʿi l-khayrāti fī l-ḥayāti wa baʿda l-mamāt
and by which You bring us to the furthest goals of every good, in life and after death
يَاۤ رَبِّ يَاۤ اَللهُ يَاۤ مُجِيْبَ الدَّعَوَاتِ ۝
yā Rabbi, yā Allāhu, yā Mujība d-daʿawāt
O my Lord, O Allāh, O Answerer of supplications
اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّـيْ أَسْأَلُكَ أنْ تَجْعَلَ لِـيْ فِـيْ مُدَّةِ حَيَاتِـيْ وَبَعْدَ مَمَاتِـيْ أَضْعَافَ أَضْعَافِ ذٰلِكَ أَلْفَ أَلْفِ صَلَاةٍ وَّسَلَامٍ مَّضْرُوْبِيْنَ فِـيْ مِثْلِ ذٰلِكَ ۝
Allāhumma innī asʾaluka an tajʿala lī fī muddati ḥayātī wa baʿda mamātī aḍʿāfa aḍʿāfi dhālika alfa alfi ṣalātin wa salāmin maḍrūbayni fī mithli dhālik
O Allāh, I ask You to appoint for me, during my lifetime and after my death, manifold multiples of that — a thousand thousand blessings and salutations, multiplied by the like of that

وَأَمْثَالَ أَمْثَالِ ذٰلِكَ عَلَىٰ عَبْدِكَ وَنَبِيِّكَ وَرَسُوْلِكَ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدِ النَّبِيِّ الْأُمِّيِّ وَالرَّسُوْلِ الْعَرَبِـيِّ وَعَلَىٰ آلِهٖ وَأَصْحَابِهٖ وَأَوْلَادِهٖ وَأَزْوَاجِهٖ وَذُرِّيَاتِهٖ وَأَهْلِ بَيْتِهٖ وَأَصْهَارِهٖ وَأَنْصَارِهٖ وَأَشْيَاعِهٖ وَأَتْبَاعِهٖ وَمَوَالِيْهٖ وَخُدَّامِهٖ وَحُجَّابِهٖ ۝

wa amthāla amthāli dhālika ʿalā ʿabdika wa nabiyyika wa rasūlika sayyidinā Muḥammadin an-nabiyyi l-ummiyyi wa r-rasūli l-ʿarabī, wa ʿalā ālihi wa aṣḥābihi wa awlādihi wa azwājihi wa dhurriyyātihi wa ahli baytihi wa aṣhārihi wa anṣārihi wa ashyāʿihi wa atbāʿihi wa mawālīhi wa khuddāmihi wa ḥujjābih

and the likes of the likes of that, upon Your servant, Your prophet and Your messenger, our master Muḥammad the unlettered Prophet and Arab Messenger; and upon his family, his Companions, his children, his wives, his descendants, the people of his house, his kin by marriage, his helpers, his adherents, his followers, his clients, his servants and his attendants
اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْ كُلَّ صَلَاةٍ مِنْ كُلِّ ذٰلِكَ تَفُوْقُ وَتَفْضُلُ صَلَاةَ الْمُصَلِّيْنَ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَهْلِ السَّمٰوَاتِ وَأَهْلِ الْأَرْضِيْنَ أَجْمَعِيْنَ ۝
Allāhumma jʿal kulla ṣalātin min kulli dhālika tafūqu wa tafḍulu ṣalāta l-muṣallīna ʿalayhi min ahli s-samāwāti wa ahli l-arḍīna ajmaʿīn
O Allāh, make every blessing of all of that surpass and excel the blessings of all who bless him among the people of the heavens and the people of the earths together
كَفَضْلِهِ الَّذِيْ فَضَّلْتَهٗ عَلَىٰ كَافَّةِ خَلْقِكَ يَاۤ أَكْرَمَ الْأَكْرَمِيْنَ ۝
ka-faḍlihi lladhī faḍḍaltahu ʿalā kāffati khalqika yā Akrama l-akramīn
as is his excellence, by which You favoured him above the whole of Your creation, O Most Generous of the generous
وَيَاۤ أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ ۝
wa yā Arḥama r-rāḥimīn
and O Most Merciful of those who show mercy
﴿ رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّاؕ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ السَّمِيْعُ الْعَلِيْمُ۝ وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَاۚ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيْمُ۝ ﴾
⟨ Rabbanā taqabbal minnā, innaka anta s-Samīʿu l-ʿAlīm. Wa tub ʿalaynā, innaka anta t-Tawwābu r-Raḥīm. ⟩
⟨ Our Lord, accept from us; truly You are the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing. And turn to us; truly You are the Ever-Relenting, the Merciful. ⟩
Saturday وِرْدُ يَوْمِ السَّبْتِ

اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَكَرِّمْ عَلَىٰ سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَنَبِيِّكَ وَرَسُوْلِكَ النَّبِيِّ الْأُمِّيِّ السَّيِّدِ الْكَامِلِ الْفَاتِحِ الْخَاتِمِ حَآءِ الرَّحْمَةِ وَمِيْمِ الْمُلْكِ وَدَالِ الدَّوَامِ بَحْرِ أَنْوَارِكَ وَمَعْدِنِ أَسْرَارِكَ وَلِسَانِ حُجَّتِكَ وَعَرُوْسِ مَمْلَكَتِكَ وَعَيْنِ أَعْيَانِ خَلِيْقَتِكَ وَصَفِيِّكَ السَّابِقِ لِلْخَلْقِ نُوْرُهُ الرَّحْمَةِ لِلْعَالَمِيْنَ ظُهُوْرُهُ ۝

Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa karrim ʿalā sayyidinā wa mawlānā Muḥammadin — ʿabdika wa nabiyyika wa rasūlika, an-nabiyyi l-ummiyyi, as-sayyidi l-kāmili, al-Fātiḥi l-Khātim, ḥāʾi r-raḥmati wa mīmi l-mulki wa dāli d-dawām, baḥri anwārika wa maʿdini asrārika wa lisāni ḥujjatika wa ʿarūsi mamlakatika wa ʿayni aʿyāni khalīqatika wa ṣafiyyika — as-sābiqi li-l-khalqi nūruh, ar-raḥmati li-l-ʿālamīna ẓuhūruh

O Allāh, bless, grant peace and honour to our master and patron Muḥammad — Your servant, Your prophet and Your messenger, the unlettered Prophet, the perfected master, the Opener and the Seal; the ḥāʾ of mercy, the mīm of dominion and the dāl of perpetuity; the sea of Your lights and the mine of Your secrets, the tongue of Your proof, the bride of Your kingdom, the choicest of the choice of Your creation and Your chosen one — whose light preceded creation, whose appearing was a mercy to the worlds

اَلْمُصْطَفٰى الْمُجْتَبَى الْمُنْتَقَى الْمُرْتَضٰى عَيْنِ الْعِنَايَةِ وَزَيْنِ الْقِيَامَةِ وَكَنْزِ الْهِدَايَةِ وَإِمَامِ الْحَضْرَةِ وَأَمِيْنِ الْمَمْلَكَةِ وَطِرَازِ الْحُلَّةِ وَكَنْزِ الْحَقِيْقَةِ وَشَمْسِ الشَّرِيْعَةِ وَكَاشِفِ دَيَاجِي الظُّلْمَةِ وَنَاصِرِ الْمِلَّةِ وَنَبِيِّ الرَّحْمَةِ وَشَفِيْعِ الْأُمَّةِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ۝

al-Muṣṭafā l-Mujtabā l-Muntaqā l-Murtaḍā, ʿayni l-ʿināyati wa zayni l-qiyāmati wa kanzi l-hidāyati wa imāmi l-ḥaḍrati wa amīni l-mamlakati wa ṭirāzi l-ḥullati wa kanzi l-ḥaqīqati wa shamsi sh-sharīʿati wa kāshifi dayājī ẓ-ẓulmati wa nāṣiri l-millati wa nabiyyi r-raḥmati wa shafīʿi l-ummati yawma l-qiyāma

the Chosen, the Elect, the Selected, the Well-Pleasing; the very eye of solicitude, the adornment of the Rising, the treasure of guidance, the imām of the Presence, the trustee of the kingdom, the embroidery of the robe, the treasure of the Reality, the sun of the sacred law, the dispeller of the shrouds of darkness, the helper of the religion, the prophet of mercy, and the intercessor for the community on the Day of Rising
يَوْمَ تَخْشَعُ الْأَصْوَاتُ وَتَشْخَصُ الْأَبْصَارُ ۝
yawma takhshaʿu l-aṣwātu wa tashkhaṣu l-abṣār
the day when voices are hushed and eyes stare fixed

اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَىٰ سَيِّدِنَا وَنَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدِ النُّوْرِ الْأَبْلَجِ وَالْبَهَآءِ الْأَبْهَجِ نَامُوْسِ تَوْرَاةِ مُوْسٰى وَقَامُوْسِ إِنْجِيْلِ عِيْسٰى صَلَوَاتُ اللهِ وَسَلَامُهٗ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَيْهِمْ أَجْمَعِيْنَ ۝

Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim ʿalā sayyidinā wa nabiyyinā Muḥammad — an-nūri l-ablaji wa l-bahāʾi l-abhaj, nāmūsi Tawrāti Mūsā wa qāmūsi Injīli ʿĪsā — ṣalawātu llāhi wa salāmuhu ʿalayhi wa ʿalayhim ajmaʿīn

O Allāh, bless and grant peace to our master and our prophet Muḥammad — the resplendent light and the most joyous splendour; the sacred law of the Torah of Mūsā and the ocean-lexicon of the Gospel of ʿĪsā — the blessings of Allāh and His peace be upon him and upon them all
طِلَّسْمِ الْفَلَكِ الْأَطْلَسِ فِـيْ بُطُوْنِ كُنْتُ كَنْزًا مَّخْفِيًّا فَأَحْبَبْتُ أَنْ اُعْرَفَ ۝
ṭillasmi l-falaki l-aṭlasi fī buṭūni “kuntu kanzan makhfiyyan fa-aḥbabtu an uʿraf”
the talisman of the starless sphere, within the hidden depths of “I was a hidden treasure and I loved to be known”
طَاوُوْسِ الْمُلْكِ الْمُقَدَّسِ فِـيْ ظُهُوْرِ فَخَلَقْتُ خَلْقًا فَتَعَرَّفْتُ إِلَيْهِمْ فَبِـيْ عَرَفُوْنِـيْ ۝
ṭāwūsi l-mulki l-muqaddasi fī ẓuhūri “fa-khalaqtu khalqan fa-taʿarraftu ilayhim fa-bī ʿarafūnī”
the peacock of the hallowed dominion, in the manifesting of “so I created creation, and made Myself known to them, and through Me they knew Me”
قُرَّةِ عَيْنِ الْيَقِيْنِ مِرْآةِ اُولِـي الْعَزْمِ مِنَ الْمُرْسَلِيْنَ إِلَىٰ شُهُوْدِ الْمَلِكِ الْحَقِّ الْمُبِيْنِ ۝
qurrati ʿayni l-yaqīn, mirʾāti ulī l-ʿazmi mina l-mursalīna ilā shuhūdi l-Maliki l-Ḥaqqi l-Mubīn
the coolness of the eye of certainty; the mirror of the messengers of firm resolve unto the witnessing of the King, the Real, the Manifest
نُوْرِ أَنْوَارِ أَبْصَارِ بَصَائِرِ الْأَنْۢبِيَاءِ الْمُكَرَّمِيْنَ ۝
nūri anwāri abṣāri baṣāʾiri l-anbiyāʾi l-mukarramīn
the light of the lights of the sight of the inner vision of the honoured prophets
وَمَحَلِّ نَظَرِكَ وَسَعَةِ رَحْمَتِكَ مِنَ الْعَوَالِمِ الْأَوَّلِيْنَ وَالْآخِرِيْنَ ۝
wa maḥalli naẓarika wa saʿati raḥmatika mina l-ʿawālimi l-awwalīna wa l-ākhirīn
and the place of Your regard and the breadth of Your mercy, among the worlds of the first and the last
صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَىٰ إِخْوَانِهٖ مِنَ النَّبِيّيْنَ وَالْمُرْسَلِيْنَ وَعَلَىٰ آلِهٖ وَأَصْحَابِهِ الطَّيِّبِيْنَ الطَّاهِرِيْنَ ۝
ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ikhwānihi mina n-nabiyyīna wa l-mursalīn, wa ʿalā ālihi wa aṣḥābihi ṭ-ṭayyibīna ṭ-ṭāhirīn
may Allāh bless him and his brethren among the prophets and messengers, and his family and his Companions, the good and the pure

اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَأَتْحِفْ وَأَنْعِمْ وَامْنَحْ وَأَكْرِمْ وَأَجْزِلْ وَأَعْظِمْ أَفْضَلَ صَلَوَاتِكَ وَأَوْفٰـى سَلَامِكَ صَلَاةً وَّسَلَامًا يَّتَنَزَّلَانِ مِنْ اُفُقِ كُنْهِ بَاطِنِ الذَّاتِ إِلَىٰ فَلَكِ سَمَآءِ مَظَاهِرِ الْأَسْمَآءِ وَالصِّفَاتِ وَيَرْتَقِيَانِ عِنْدَ سِدْرَةِ مُنْتَهَى الْعَارِفِيْنَ إِلَىٰ مَرْكَزِ جَلَالِ النُّوْرِ الْمُبِيْنِ عَلَىٰ سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَنَبِيِّكَ وَرَسُوْلِكَ عِلْمِ يَقِيْنِ الْعُلَمَاءِ الرَّبَّانِيِّيْنَ وَعَيْنِ يَقيْنِ الْخُلَفَاءِ الرَّاشِدِيْنَ ۝

Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa atḥif wa anʿim wa-mnaḥ wa akrim wa ajzil wa aʿẓim afḍala ṣalawātika wa awfā salāmika — ṣalātan wa salāman yatanazzalāni min ufuqi kunhi bāṭini dh-dhāti ilā falaki samāʾi maẓāhiri l-asmāʾi wa ṣ-ṣifāt, wa yartaqiyāni ʿinda sidrati muntahā l-ʿārifīna ilā markazi jalāli n-nūri l-mubīn — ʿalā sayyidinā wa mawlānā Muḥammadin ʿabdika wa nabiyyika wa rasūlika, ʿilmi yaqīni l-ʿulamāʾi r-rabbāniyyīn, wa ʿayni yaqīni l-khulafāʾi r-rāshidīn

O Allāh, bless and grant peace, bestow gifts and favours, grant and honour, give abundantly and magnify — the most excellent of Your blessings and the fullest of Your peace: a blessing and a peace that descend from the horizon of the very essence of the inward Essence to the sphere of the heaven of the loci of the Names and Attributes, and that ascend at the Lote-Tree of the furthest limit of the gnostics to the centre of the majesty of the Manifest Light — upon our master and patron Muḥammad, Your servant, Your prophet and Your messenger: the knowledge of certainty of the Lordly scholars, and the eye of certainty of the Rightly-Guided Caliphs
وَحَقِّ يَقِيْنِ الْأَنْۢبِيَاءِ الْمُكَرَّمِيْنَ ۝
wa ḥaqqi yaqīni l-anbiyāʾi l-mukarramīn
and the truth of certainty of the honoured prophets
اَلَّذِيْ تَاهَتْ فِـيْ أَنْوَارِ جَلَالِهٖ اُولُو الْعَزْمِ مِنَ الْمُرْسَلِيْنَ وَتَحَيَّرَتْ فِـيْ دَرْكِ حَقَائِقِهٖ عُظَمَاءُ الْمَلَائِكَةِ الْمُهَيَّمِيْنَ ۝
alladhī tāhat fī anwāri jalālihi ulū l-ʿazmi mina l-mursalīn, wa taḥayyarat fī darki ḥaqāʾiqihi ʿuẓamāʾu l-malāʾikati l-muhayyamīn
he in the lights of whose majesty the messengers of firm resolve were lost, and in the grasping of whose realities the greatest of the enraptured angels were bewildered
اَلْمُنَزَّلِ عَلَيْهِ فِـي الْقُرْآنِ الْعَظِيْمِ بِلِسَانٍ عَرَبِـيٍّ مُّبِيْنٍ ۝
al-munazzali ʿalayhi fī l-Qurʾāni l-ʿaẓīmi bi-lisānin ʿarabiyyin mubīn
upon whom it was sent down in the mighty Qurʾān, in a clear Arabic tongue

﴿ لَقَدْ مَنَّ اللهُ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ إِذْ بَعَثَ فِيْهِمْ رَسُوْلًا مِّنْ أَنْفُسِهِمْ يَتْلُوْ عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتِهٖ وَيُزَكِّيْهِمْ وَيُعَلِّمُهُمُ الْكِتَابَ وَالْحِكْمَةَۚ وَإِنْ كَانُوْا مِنْ قَبْلُ لَفِيْ ضَلَالٍ مُّبِيْنٍ ۝ ﴾ اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ صَلَاةَ ذَاتِكَ عَلَىٰ حَضْرَةِ صِفَاتِكَ الْجَامِعِ لِكُلِّ الْكَمَالِ ۝

⟨ Laqad manna llāhu ʿalā l-muʾminīna idh baʿatha fīhim rasūlan min anfusihim yatlū ʿalayhim āyātihi wa yuzakkīhim wa yuʿallimuhumu l-kitāba wa l-ḥikma, wa in kānū min qablu la-fī ḍalālin mubīn. ⟩ Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim ṣalāta dhātika ʿalā ḥaḍrati ṣifātika, al-jāmiʿi li-kulli l-kamāl

⟨ Allāh has surely favoured the believers in raising up among them a Messenger from themselves, reciting to them His signs, purifying them and teaching them the Book and the wisdom, though before they were in manifest error. ⟩ O Allāh, bless and grant peace with the blessing of Your Essence upon the presence of Your Attributes — he who gathers every perfection
اَلْمُتَّصِفِ بِصِفَاتِ الْجَلَالِ وَالْجَمَالِ ۝
al-muttaṣifi bi-ṣifāti l-jalāli wa l-jamāl
qualified by the attributes of majesty and of beauty
مَنْ تَنَزَّهَ عَنِ الْمَخْلُوْقِيْنَ فِـي الْمِثَالِ ۝
man tanazzaha ʿani l-makhlūqīna fī l-mithāl
he who is set far above created things in likeness
يَنْۢبُوْعِ الْمَعَارِفِ الرَّبَّانِيَّةِ ۝
yanbūʿi l-maʿārifi r-rabbāniyya
the wellspring of the Lordly sciences of gnosis
وَحِيْطَةِ الْأَسْرَارِ الْإِلٰهِيَّةِ ۝
wa ḥīṭati l-asrāri l-ilāhiyya
and the enclosure of the divine secrets
غَايَةِ مُنْتَهَى السَّائِلِيْنَ ۝
ghāyati muntahā s-sāʾilīn
the utmost end of those who ask
وَدَلِيْلِ كُلِّ حَآئِرٍ مِّنَ السَّالِكِيْنَ ۝
wa dalīli kulli ḥāʾirin mina s-sālikīn
and the guide of every bewildered one among the wayfarers
مُحَمَّدِ الْمَحْمُوْدِ بِالْأَوْصَافِ وَالذَّاتِ وَأَحْمَدَ مَنْ مَّضٰى وَمَنْ هُوَ آتٍ وَّسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيْمًا ۝
Muḥammadin al-maḥmūdi bi-l-awṣāfi wa dh-dhāt, wa Aḥmada man maḍā wa man huwa āt — wa sallim taslīmā
Muḥammad, praised in his qualities and in his essence, and the most praised of those who have passed and those yet to come — and grant him abundant peace
بِدَايَةِ الْأَزَلِ وَغَايَةِ الْأَبَدِ حَتّٰى لَا يَحْصُرَهٗ عَدَدٌ وَّلَا يُنْهِيْهِ أَمَدٌ ۝
bidāyati l-azali wa ghāyati l-abadi ḥattā lā yaḥṣurahu ʿadadun wa lā yunhīhi amad
from the beginning of beginninglessness to the end of endlessness, so that no number confines it and no term brings it to a close
وَارْضَ عَنْ تَوَابِعِهٖ فِـي الشَّرِيْعَةِ وَالطَّرِيْقَةِ وَالْحَقِيْقَةِ مِنَ الْأَصْحَابِ وَالْعُلَمَاءِ وَأَهْلِ الطَّرِيْقَةِ وَاجْعَلْنَا يَا مَوْلَانَا مِنْهُمْ حَقِيْقَةً، آمِيْنَ ۝
wa-rḍa ʿan tawābiʿihi fī sh-sharīʿati wa ṭ-ṭarīqati wa l-ḥaqīqati mina l-aṣḥābi wa l-ʿulamāʾi wa ahli ṭ-ṭarīqa; wa-jʿalnā yā Mawlānā minhum ḥaqīqatan — āmīn
and be pleased with those who follow him in the sacred law, the way and the Reality — among the Companions, the scholars and the people of the ṭarīqa; and make us, O our Patron, truly of them — āmīn
Sunday وِرْدُ يَوْمِ الْأَحَدِ
اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَىٰ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَّعَلَىٰ آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ فَتْحِ أَبْوَابِ حَضْرَتِكَ وَعَيْنِ عِنَايَتِكَ بِخَلْقِكَ وَرَسُوْلِكَ إِلَىٰ جِنِّكَ وَإِنْسِكَ ۝
Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammad — fatḥi abwābi ḥaḍratika, wa ʿayni ʿināyatika bi-khalqik, wa rasūlika ilā jinnika wa insik

O Allāh, bless and grant peace to our master Muḥammad and to the family of our master Muḥammad — the opening of the doors of Your Presence, the very eye of Your solicitude toward Your creation, and Your messenger to Your jinn and Your mankind
وَحْدَانِـيِّ الذَّاتِ الْمُنَزَّلِ عَلَيْهِ الْآيَاتُ الْوَاضِحَاتُ مُقِيْلِ الْعَثَرَاتِ وَسَيِّدِ السَّادَاتِ مَاحِي الشِّرْكِ وَالضَّلَالَاتِ بِالسُّيُوْفِ الصَّارِمَاتِ ۝
waḥdāniyyi dh-dhāt, al-munazzali ʿalayhi l-āyātu l-wāḍiḥāt, muqīli l-ʿatharāt, wa sayyidi s-sādāt, māḥī sh-shirki wa ḍ-ḍalālāti bi-s-suyūfi ṣ-ṣārimāt
singular in essence; upon whom the clear signs were sent down; the pardoner of stumbles and the master of masters; the effacer of associationism and of errors by the keen swords
اَلْآمِرِ بِالْمَعْرُوْفِ وَالنَّاهِيْ عَنِ الْمُنْكِرَاتِ ۝
al-āmiri bi-l-maʿrūfi wa n-nāhī ʿani l-munkarāt
who commands what is right and forbids what is wrong

اَلثَّامِلِ مِنْ شَرَابِ الْمُشَاهَدَاتِ، اَلْمُسْقٰى مِنْ أَسْرَارِ الْقُدْسِيَّاتِ، اَلْعَالِمِ بِالْمَاضِيْ وَالْمُسْتَقْبَلَاتِ، سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ خَيْرِ الْبَرِيَّاتِ مَا دَامَتِ الْأَرْضُ وَالسَّمٰوَاتُ ۝

ath-thāmili min sharābi l-mushāhadāt, al-musqā min asrāri l-qudsiyyāt, al-ʿālimi bi-l-māḍī wa l-mustaqbalāt — sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam, khayri l-bariyyāti mā dāmati l-arḍu wa s-samāwāt

who has drunk deep of the wine of direct witnessings; who is given to drink of the holy secrets; who knows what is past and what is to come — our master Muḥammad, may Allāh bless him and grant him peace, the best of creation for as long as earth and heavens endure

اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَىٰ مَنْ لَّهُ الْأَخْلَاقُ الرَّضِيَّةُ، وَالْأَوْصَافُ الْمَرْضِيَّةُ، وَالْأَقْوَالُ الشَّرْعِيَّةُ، وَالْأَحْوَالُ الْحَقِيْقِيَّةُ، وَالْعِنَايَاتُ الْأَزَلِيَّةُ، وَالسَّعَادَاتُ الْأَبَدِيَّةُ، وَالْفُتُوْحَاتُ الْمَكِّيَّةُ، وَالظُّهُوْرَاتُ الْمَدَنِيَّةُ، وَالْكَمَالَاتُ الْإِلٰهِيَّةُ، وَالْمَعَالِمُ الرَّبَّانِيَّةُ، وَسِرُّ الْبَرِيَّةُ ۝

Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim ʿalā man lahu l-akhlāqu r-raḍiyya, wa l-awṣāfu l-marḍiyya, wa l-aqwālu sh-sharʿiyya, wa l-aḥwālu l-ḥaqīqiyya, wa l-ʿināyātu l-azaliyya, wa s-saʿādātu l-abadiyya, wa l-futūḥātu l-Makkiyya, wa ẓ-ẓuhūrātu l-Madaniyya, wa l-kamālātu l-ilāhiyya, wa l-maʿālimu r-rabbāniyya, wa sirru l-bariyya

O Allāh, bless and grant peace to him who possesses the contented character and the pleasing qualities; whose words are of the sacred law and whose states are of the Reality; who has the solicitude that is without beginning and the felicities that are without end; the Makkan openings and the Madinan manifestations; the divine perfections and the Lordly landmarks — and the secret of creation
وَشَفِيْعِنَا يَوْمَ بَعْثِنَا، اَلْمُسْتَغْفِرِ لَنَا عِنْدَ رَبِّنَا، اَلدَّاعِيْ إِلَيْكَ وَالْمُقْتَدٰى لِمَنْ أَرَادَ الْوُصُوْلَ إِلَيْكَ ۝
wa shafīʿinā yawma baʿthinā, al-mustaghfiri lanā ʿinda rabbinā, ad-dāʿī ilayka wa l-muqtadā li-man arāda l-wuṣūla ilayk
and our intercessor on the day of our raising; who seeks forgiveness for us with our Lord; who calls to You, and who is the exemplar for whoever desires to arrive at You

اَلْأَنِيْسِ بِكَ وَالْمُسْتَوْحِشِ مِنْ غَيْرِكَ حَتّٰى تَمَتَّعَ مِنْ نُّوْرِ ذَاتِكَ ورَجَعَ بِكَ، لَا بِغَيْرِكَ، وَشَهِدَ وَحْدَتَكَ فِـيْ كَثْرَتِكَ، وَقُلْتَ لَهٗ بِلِسَانِ حَالِكَ وَقَوَّيْتَهٗ بِكَلَامِكَ ﴿ فَاصْدَعْ بِمَا تُؤْمَرُ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ الْمُشْرِكِيْنَ ۝ ﴾ اَلذَّاكِرِ لَكَ فِـيْ لَيْلِكَ وَالصَّائِمِ لَكَ فِـيْ نَهَارِكَ ۝

al-anīsi bika wa l-mustawḥishi min ghayrik, ḥattā tamattaʿa min nūri dhātika wa rajaʿa bika lā bi-ghayrik, wa shahida waḥdataka fī kathratik; wa qulta lahu bi-lisāni ḥālika wa qawwaytahu bi-kalāmik: ⟨ fa-ṣdaʿ bimā tuʾmaru wa aʿriḍ ʿani l-mushrikīn ⟩ — adh-dhākiri laka fī laylika wa ṣ-ṣāʾimi laka fī nahārik

intimate with You and estranged from all besides You, until he took his delight from the light of Your Essence and returned by You and not by another, and witnessed Your oneness within Your multiplicity; and You said to him by the tongue of Your state and strengthened him by Your speech: ⟨ so proclaim what you are commanded, and turn away from those who associate ⟩ — who remembers You in Your night and fasts for You in Your day
اَلْمَعْرُوْفِ عِنْدَ مَلَائِكَتِكَ أَنَّهُ خَيْرُ خَلْقِكَ ۝
al-maʿrūfi ʿinda malāʾikatika annahu khayru khalqik
known among Your angels to be the best of Your creation

اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنَّا نَتَوَسَّلُ إِلَيْكَ بِالْحَرْفِ الْجَامِعِ لِمَعَانِـيْ كَمَالِكَ، نَسْأَلُكَ إِيَّاكَ بِكَ أَنْ تُرِيَنَا وَجْهَ نَبِيِّنَا صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَأَنْ تَمْحُوَ عَنَّا وُجُوْدَ ذُنُوْبِنَا بِمُشَاهَدَةِ جَمَالِكَ وَتُغَيِّبَنَا عَنَّا فِـيْ بِحَارِ أَنْوَارِكَ مَعْصُوْمِيْنَ مِنَ الشَّوَاغِلِ الدُّنْيَوِيَّةِ، رَاغِبِيْنَ إِلَيْكَ، غَائِبِيْنَ بِكَ، يَآ هُوَ يَآ اَللهُ، يَآ هُوَ يَآ اَللهُ ، يَآ هُوَ يَآ اَللهُ، لَا إِلٰهَ غَيْرُكَ ۝

Allāhumma innā natawassalu ilayka bi-l-ḥarfi l-jāmiʿi li-maʿānī kamālik; nasʾaluka iyyāka bika an turiyanā wajha nabiyyinā ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam, wa an tamḥuwa ʿannā wujūda dhunūbinā bi-mushāhadati jamālik, wa tughayyibanā ʿannā fī biḥāri anwārika maʿṣūmīna mina sh-shawāghili d-dunyawiyya, rāghibīna ilayk, ghāʾibīna bik. Yā Huwa yā Allāh — three times — lā ilāha ghayruk.

O Allāh, we seek a means to You by the letter that gathers the meanings of Your perfection; we ask You, by You, for You: that You show us the face of our Prophet, may Allāh bless him and grant him peace; that You efface from us the very existence of our sins by the witnessing of Your beauty; and that You make us absent from ourselves in the seas of Your lights, preserved from worldly distractions, desiring You, absent through You. O He, O Allāh — three times — there is no god but You.

اَسْقِنَا مِنْ شَرَابِ مَحَبَّتِكَ وَاغْمِسْنَا فِـيْ بِحَارِ أَحَدِيَّتِكَ حَتّٰى نَرْتَعَ فِـيْ بَحْبُوْحَةِ حَضْرَتِكَ، وَتَقْطَعَ عَنَّا أَوْهَامَ خَلِيْقَتِكَ بِفَضْلِكَ وَرَحْمَتِكَ، وَنَوِّرْنَا بِنُوْرِ طَاعَتِكَ، وَاهْدِنَا وَلَا تُضِلَّنَا، وَبَصِّرْنَا بِعُيُوْبِنَا عَنْ عُيُوْبِ غَيْرِنَا، بِحُرْمَةِ نَبِيِّنَا وَسَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَىٰ آلِهٖ وَأَصْحَابِهٖ مَصَابِيْحِ الْوُجُوْدِ، وَأَهْلِ الشُّهُوْدِ، يَاۤ أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ ۝

Asqinā min sharābi maḥabbatika wa-ghmisnā fī biḥāri aḥadiyyatika ḥattā nartaʿa fī baḥbūḥati ḥaḍratik, wa taqṭaʿa ʿannā awhāma khalīqatika bi-faḍlika wa raḥmatik; wa nawwirnā bi-nūri ṭāʿatik, wa-hdinā wa lā tuḍillanā, wa baṣṣirnā bi-ʿuyūbinā ʿan ʿuyūbi ghayrinā — bi-ḥurmati nabiyyinā wa sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālihi wa aṣḥābihi, maṣābīḥi l-wujūdi wa ahli sh-shuhūd, yā Arḥama r-rāḥimīn

Give us to drink of the wine of Your love, and immerse us in the seas of Your uniqueness, until we pasture in the very midst of Your Presence, and until You sever from us the illusions of Your creation by Your grace and Your mercy. Illumine us with the light of obedience to You; guide us and do not let us stray; and make us see our own faults rather than the faults of others — by the sanctity of our Prophet and master Muḥammad, may Allāh bless him and his family and his Companions, the lamps of existence and the people of witnessing, O Most Merciful of those who show mercy
نَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُلْحِقَنَا بِهِمْ وَتَمْنَحَنَا حُبَّهُمْ، يَا اَللهُ، يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّوْمُ، يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ۝
nasʾaluka an tulḥiqanā bihim wa tamnaḥanā ḥubbahum. Yā Allāh, yā Ḥayyu yā Qayyūm, yā Dhā l-jalāli wa l-ikrām
we ask You to join us to them and to grant us their love. O Allāh, O Living, O Self-Subsisting, O Possessor of majesty and honour

﴿ رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّاؕ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ السَّمِيْعُ الْعَلِيْمُ۝ وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَاۚ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيْمُ۝ ﴾ وَهَبْ لَنَا مَعْرِفَةً نَّافِعَةً إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ، يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ، يَا رَحْمٰنُ يَا رَحِيْمُ، نَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تَرْزُقَنَا رُؤْيَةَ وَجْهِ نَبِيِّنَا فِـيْ مَنَامِنَا وَيَقْظَتِنَا، وَأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ وَتُسَلِّمَ عَلَيْهِ صَلَاةً دَائِمَةً إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ الدِّيْنِ، وَأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ خَيْرِنَا وَكُنْ لَّنَا ۝

⟨ Rabbanā taqabbal minnā, innaka anta s-Samīʿu l-ʿAlīm. Wa tub ʿalaynā, innaka anta t-Tawwābu r-Raḥīm. ⟩ Wa hab lanā maʿrifatan nāfiʿatan; innaka ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr. Yā Rabba l-ʿālamīn, yā Raḥmānu yā Raḥīm: nasʾaluka an tarzuqanā ruʾyata wajhi nabiyyinā fī manāminā wa yaqẓatinā, wa an tuṣalliya wa tusallima ʿalayhi ṣalātan dāʾimatan ilā yawmi d-dīn, wa an tuṣalliya ʿalā khayrinā wa kun lanā

⟨ Our Lord, accept from us; truly You are the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing. And turn to us; truly You are the Ever-Relenting, the Merciful. ⟩ And grant us a beneficial knowledge; You have power over all things. O Lord of the worlds, O All-Merciful, O Ever-Merciful: we ask You to grant us the sight of the face of our Prophet in our sleep and in our waking; and to bless him and grant him peace with a blessing enduring until the Day of Judgement; and to bless the best of us, and be for us
Monday وِرْدُ يَوْمِ الْإِثْنَيْنِ

اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْ أَفْضَلَ صَلَوَاتِكَ أَبَدًا، وَأَنْمٰى بَرَكَاتِكَ سَرْمَدًا، وَأَزْكٰى تَحِيَّاتِكَ فَضْلًا وَّعَدَدًا، عَلَىٰ أَشْرَفِ الْحَقَائِقِ الْإِنْسَانِيَّةِ وَالْجَانِّيَّةِ، وَمَجْمَعِ الدَّقَائِقِ الْإِيْمَانِيَّةِ، طُوْرِ التَّجَلِّيَاتِ الْإِحْسَانِيَّةِ، وَمَهْبَطِ الْأَسْرَارِ الرَّحْمَانِيَّةِ، وَعَرُوْسِ الْمَمْلَكَةِ الرَّبَّانِيَّةِ، وَاسِطَةِ عِقْدِ النَّبِيِّيْنَ، مُقَدِّمَةِ جَيْشِ الْمُرْسَلِيْنَ، وَقَائِدِ رَكْبِ الْأَوْلِيَاۤءِ وَالصِّدِّيْقِيْنَ، وَأَفْضَلِ الْخَلَائِقِ أَجْمَعِيْنِ، حَامِلِ لِوَاءِ الْعِزِّ الْأَعْلَىٰ، وَمَالِكِ أَزِمَّةِ الْمَجْدِ الْأَسْنٰى، شَاهِدِ أَسْرَارِ الْأَزَلِ، وَمُشَاهِدِ أَنْوَارِ السَّوَابِقِ الْأُوَلِ، وَتَرْجُمَانِ لِسَانِ الْقِدَمِ، وَمَنْۢبَعِ الْعِلْمِ وَالْحِلْمِ وَالْحِكَمِ، مَظْهَرِ سِرِّ الْوُجُوْدِ الْجُزْئِـيِّ وَالْكُلِّيِّ، وَإِنْسَانِ عَيْنِ الْوُجُوْدِ الْعُلْوِيِّ وَالسُّفْلِيِّ، رُوْحِ جَسَدِ الْكَوْنَيْنِ، وَعَيْنِ حَيَاةِ الدَّارَيْنِ، اَلْمُتَحَقِّقِ بِأَعْلَىٰ رُتَبِ الْعُبُوْدِيَّةِ، وَالْمُتَخَلِّقِ بِأَخْلَاقِ الْمَقَامَاتِ الْاِصْطِفَائِيَّةِ، اَلْخَلِيْلِ الْأَعْظَمِ وَالْحَبِيْبِ الْأَكْرَمِ، سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا وَحَبِيْبِنَا مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَىٰ آلِهٖ وَأَصْحَابِهٖ عَدَدَ مَعْلُوْمَاتِكَ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِكَ، كُلَّمَا ذَكَرَكَ وَذَكَرَهُ الذَّاكِرُوْنَ، وَغَفَلَ عَنْ ذِكْرِكَ وَذِكْرِهِ الْغَافِلُوْنَ، وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيْمًا دَاۤئِمًا كَثِيْرًا ۝

Allāhumma jʿal afḍala ṣalawātika abadan, wa anmā barakātika sarmadan, wa azkā taḥiyyātika faḍlan wa ʿadadan — ʿalā ashrafi l-ḥaqāʾiqi l-insāniyyati wa l-jānniyya, wa majmaʿi d-daqāʾiqi l-īmāniyya, ṭūri t-tajalliyāti l-iḥsāniyya, wa mahbaṭi l-asrāri r-raḥmāniyya, wa ʿarūsi l-mamlakati r-rabbāniyya, wāsiṭati ʿiqdi n-nabiyyīn, muqaddimati jayshi l-mursalīn, wa qāʾidi rakbi l-awliyāʾi wa ṣ-ṣiddīqīn, wa afḍali l-khalāʾiqi ajmaʿīn; ḥāmili liwāʾi l-ʿizzi l-aʿlā, wa māliki azimmati l-majdi l-asnā, shāhidi asrāri l-azal, wa mushāhidi anwāri s-sawābiqi l-uwal, wa tarjumāni lisāni l-qidam, wa manbaʿi l-ʿilmi wa l-ḥilmi wa l-ḥikam; maẓhari sirri l-wujūdi l-juzʾiyyi wa l-kullī, wa insāni ʿayni l-wujūdi l-ʿulwiyyi wa s-suflī, rūḥi jasadi l-kawnayn, wa ʿayni ḥayāti d-dārayn; al-mutaḥaqqiqi bi-aʿlā rutabi l-ʿubūdiyya, wa l-mutakhalliqi bi-akhlāqi l-maqāmāti l-iṣṭifāʾiyya; al-Khalīli l-aʿẓami wa l-Ḥabībi l-akram — sayyidinā wa mawlānā wa ḥabībinā Muḥammadi bni ʿAbdi llāhi bni ʿAbdi l-Muṭṭalib, ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālihi wa aṣḥābihi ʿadada maʿlūmātika wa midāda kalimātik, kullamā dhakaraka wa dhakarahu dh-dhākirūn, wa ghafala ʿan dhikrika wa dhikrihi l-ghāfilūn — wa sallim taslīman dāʾiman kathīrā

O Allāh, appoint the most excellent of Your blessings for ever, and the most increasing of Your graces everlastingly, and the purest of Your salutations in grace and in number — upon the noblest of the realities of mankind and of jinn; the gathering-place of the subtleties of faith; the Sinai of the manifestations of spiritual excellence; the descent-place of the merciful secrets; the bride of the Lordly kingdom; the centre-gem in the necklace of the prophets; the vanguard of the army of the messengers; the leader of the caravan of the friends of God and the truthful; and the most excellent of all creatures. The bearer of the banner of highest might, and the holder of the reins of loftiest glory; the witness of the secrets of pre-eternity, and the beholder of the lights of the first precedents; the interpreter of the tongue of the Eternal, and the wellspring of knowledge, forbearance and wisdom. The locus of manifestation of the secret of existence, partial and total; the pupil of the eye of existence, higher and lower; the spirit of the body of the two worlds, and the very life of the two abodes. He who is realised in the highest ranks of servanthood, and formed by the character of the stations of election; the greatest intimate friend and the most noble beloved — our master, our patron and our beloved Muḥammad son of ʿAbdullāh son of ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib. May Allāh bless him and his family and his Companions by the number of what You know and the ink of Your words, as often as those who remember remember You and him, and as often as the heedless are heedless of remembering You and him — and grant them peace, enduring and abundant

اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنَّا نَتَوَسَّلُ إِلَيْكَ بِنُوْرِهِ السَّارِيْ فِـي الْوُجُوْدِ أَنْ تُحْيِيَ قُلُوْبَنَا بِنُوْرِ حَيَاةِ قَلْبِهِ الْوَاسِعِ لِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ رَّحْمَةً وَّعِلْمًا وَّهُدًى وَّبُشْرٰى لِلْمُسْلِمِيْنَ، وَأَنْ تَشْرَحَ صُدُوْرَنَا بِنُوْرِ صَدْرِهِ الْجَامِعِ مَا فَرَّطْنَا فِـي الْكِتَابِ مِنْ شَيْءٍ وَّضِيَاءً وَّذِكْرٰى لِلْمُتَّقِيْنَ، وَتُطَهِّرَ نُفُوْسَنَا بِطَهَارَةِ نَفْسِهِ الزَّكِيَّةِ الْمَرْضِيَّةِ، وَتُعَلِّمَنَا بِأَنْوَارِ عُلُوْمِ ﴿ وَكُلَّ شَيْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَاهُ فِـيْۤ إِمَامٍ مُّبِيْنٍ۝ ﴾ وَتُسْرِيَ سَرَاۤئِرَهٗ فِيْنَا بِلَوَامِعِ أَنْوَارِكَ حَتّٰى تُفْنِيَنَا عَنَّا فِـيْ حَقِّ حَقِيْقَتِهٖ فَيَكُوْنَ هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّوْمُ فِيْنَا بِقَيُّوْمِيَّتِكَ السَّرْمَدِيَّةِ، فَنَعِيْشَ بِرُوْحِهٖ عَيْشَ الْحَيَاةِ الْأَبَدِيَّةِ ۝

Allāhumma innā natawassalu ilayka bi-nūrihi s-sārī fī l-wujūd: an tuḥyiya qulūbanā bi-nūri ḥayāti qalbihi l-wāsiʿi li-kulli shayʾin raḥmatan wa ʿilman wa hudan wa bushrā li-l-muslimīn; wa an tashraḥa ṣudūranā bi-nūri ṣadrihi l-jāmiʿi “mā farraṭnā fī l-kitābi min shayʾ”, wa ḍiyāʾan wa dhikrā li-l-muttaqīn; wa tuṭahhira nufūsanā bi-ṭahārati nafsihi z-zakiyyati l-marḍiyya; wa tuʿallimanā bi-anwāri ʿulūmi ⟨ wa kulla shayʾin aḥṣaynāhu fī imāmin mubīn ⟩ ; wa tusriya sarāʾirahu fīnā bi-lawāmiʿi anwārika ḥattā tufniyanā ʿannā fī ḥaqqi ḥaqīqatih, fa-yakūna huwa l-Ḥayya l-Qayyūma fīnā bi-qayyūmiyyatika s-sarmadiyya, fa-naʿīsha bi-rūḥihi ʿaysha l-ḥayāti l-abadiyya

O Allāh, we seek a means to You by his light that runs through all existence: that You give life to our hearts by the light of the life of his heart, which embraces all things in mercy, knowledge, guidance and glad tidings for the Muslims; that You expand our breasts by the light of his breast, which gathers “We have neglected nothing in the Book”, and radiance and a reminder for the godfearing; that You purify our souls by the purity of his soul, unsullied and well-pleasing; that You teach us by the lights of the sciences of ⟨ and everything We have reckoned in a clear register ⟩ ; and that You cause his inmost secrets to run within us by the flashes of Your lights, until You annihilate us from ourselves in the very truth of his reality, so that he becomes the Living, the Self-Subsisting within us by Your everlasting self-subsistence, and we live by his spirit the life that has no end
صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَىٰ آلِهٖ وَصَحْبِهٖ وَسَلَّمَ تَسْلِيْمًا كَثِيْرًا، ------آمِيْنَ ۝
Ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālihi wa ṣaḥbihi wa sallama taslīman kathīran — āmīn
May Allāh bless him and his family and his Companions, and grant them abundant peace — āmīn

بِفَضْلِكَ وَرَحْمَتِكَ عَلَيْنَا، يَا حَنَّانُ، يَا مَنَّانُ، يَا رَحْمٰنُ، وَبِتَجَلِّيَاتِ مُنَازَلَاتِكَ فِـيْ مِرْآةِ شُهُوْدِهٖ لِمُنَازَلَاتِ تَجَلِّيَاتِكَ فَنَكُوْنَ فِـي الْخُلَفَاۤءِ الرَّاشِدِيْنَ فِـيْ وِلَايَةِ الْأَقْرَبِيْنَ ۝

bi-faḍlika wa raḥmatika ʿalaynā, yā Ḥannānu, yā Mannānu, yā Raḥmān; wa bi-tajalliyāti munāzalātika fī mirʾāti shuhūdihi li-munāzalāti tajalliyātik, fa-nakūna fī l-khulafāʾi r-rāshidīna fī wilāyati l-aqrabīn

by Your grace and Your mercy upon us, O Ever-Compassionate, O Ever-Bountiful, O All-Merciful; and by the self-disclosures of Your descents within the mirror of his witnessing of the descents of Your self-disclosures — that we may be among the Rightly-Guided in the sanctity of those brought nearest

اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَىٰ سَيِّدِنَا وَنَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ جَمَالِ لُطْفِكَ وَحَنَانِ عَطْفِكَ وَجَلَالِ مُلْكِكَ وَكَمَالِ قُدْسِكَ النُّوْرِ الْمُطْلَقِ بِسِرِّ الْمَعِيَّةِ الَّتِيْ لَا تَتَقَيَّدُ، اَلْبَاطِنِ مَعْنًى فِـيْ غَيْبِكَ وَالظَّاهِرِ حَقًّا فِـيْ شَهَادَتِكَ، شَمْسِ الْأَسْرَارِ الرَّبَّانِيّةِ، وَمَجْلٰى حَضْرَةِ الْحَضَرَاتِ الرَّحْمَانِيَّةِ، مَنَازِلِ الْكُتُبِ الْقَيِّمَةِ، نُوْرِ الْآيَاتِ الْبَيِّنَةِ، اَلَّذِيْ خَلَقْتَهٗ مِنْ نُّوْرِ ذَاتِكَ وَحَقَّقْتَهٗ بِأَسْمَاۤئِكَ وَصِفَاتِكَ، وَخَلَقْتَ مِنْ نُّوْرِهِ الْأَنْۢبِيَاۤءَ وَالْمُرْسَلِيْنَ، وَتَعَرَّفْتَ إِلَيْهِمْ بِأَخْذِ الْمِيْثَاقِ عَلَيْهِمْ بِقَوْلِكَ الْحَقِّ الْمُبِيْنِ: ﴿ وَإِذْ أَخَذَ اللهُ مِيْثَاقَ النَّبِيِّيْنَ لَمَاۤ اٰتَيْتُكُمْ مِّنْ كِتَابٍ وَّحِكْمَةٍ ثُمَّ جَآءَكُمْ رَسُوْلٌ مُّصَدِّقٌ لِّمَا مَعَكُمْ لَتُؤْمِنُنَّ بِهٖ وَلَتَنْصُرُنَّهٗؕ قَالَ أَأَقْرَرْتُمْ وَأَخَذْتُمْ عَلَىٰ ذَلِكُمْ إِصْرِيْؕ قَالُـوْۤا أَقْرَرْنَاؕ قَالَ فَاشْهَدُوْا وَأَنَا مَعَكُمْ مِّنَ الشَّاهِدِيْنَ۝ ﴾ اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَىٰ بَهْجَةِ الْكَمَالِ وَتَاجِ الْجَلَالِ وَبَهَاءِ الْجَمَالِ وَشَمْسِ الْوِصَالِ وَعَبَقِ الْوُجُوْدِ وَحَيَاةِ كُلِّ مَوْجُوْدٍ، عِزِّ جَلَالِ سَلْطَنَتِكَ وَجَلَالِ عِزِّ مَمْلَكَتِكَ وَمَلِيْكِ صُنْعِ قُدْرَتِكَ وَطِرَازِ صَفْوَةِ الصَّفْوَةِ مِنْ أَهْلِ صَفْوَتِكَ وَخُلَاصَةِ الْخَاصَّةِ مِنْ أَهْلِ قُرْبِكَ، سِرِّ اللهِ الْأَعْظَمِ وَحَبِيْبِ اللهِ الْأَكْرَمِ وَخَلِيْلِ اللهِ الْمُكَرَّمِ، سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ۝

Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim ʿalā sayyidinā wa nabiyyinā Muḥammad — jamāli luṭfika wa ḥanāni ʿaṭfika, wa jalāli mulkika wa kamāli qudsika; an-nūri l-muṭlaqi bi-sirri l-maʿiyyati llatī lā tataqayyad; al-bāṭini maʿnan fī ghaybika wa ẓ-ẓāhiri ḥaqqan fī shahādatik; shamsi l-asrāri r-rabbāniyya, wa majlā ḥaḍrati l-ḥaḍarāti r-raḥmāniyya; manāzili l-kutubi l-qayyima, nūri l-āyāti l-bayyina — alladhī khalaqtahu min nūri dhātika wa ḥaqqaqtahu bi-asmāʾika wa ṣifātik, wa khalaqta min nūrihi l-anbiyāʾa wa l-mursalīn, wa taʿarrafta ilayhim bi-akhdhi l-mīthāqi ʿalayhim bi-qawlika l-ḥaqqi l-mubīn: ⟨ wa idh akhadha llāhu mīthāqa n-nabiyyīna lamā ātaytukum min kitābin wa ḥikmatin thumma jāʾakum rasūlun muṣaddiqun limā maʿakum la-tuʾminunna bihi wa la-tanṣurunnah; qāla a-aqrartum wa akhadhtum ʿalā dhālikum iṣrī; qālū aqrarnā; qāla fa-shhadū wa anā maʿakum mina sh-shāhidīn ⟩ . Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim ʿalā bahjati l-kamāli wa tāji l-jalāli wa bahāʾi l-jamāli wa shamsi l-wiṣāli wa ʿabaqi l-wujūdi wa ḥayāti kulli mawjūd; ʿizzi jalāli salṭanatika wa jalāli ʿizzi mamlakatika wa malīki ṣunʿi qudratika; wa ṭirāzi ṣafwati ṣ-ṣafwati min ahli ṣafwatik, wa khulāṣati l-khāṣṣati min ahli qurbik; sirri llāhi l-aʿẓam, wa Ḥabībi llāhi l-akram, wa Khalīli llāhi l-mukarram — sayyidinā wa mawlānā Muḥammadin ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam

O Allāh, bless and grant peace to our master and our prophet Muḥammad — the beauty of Your gentleness and the tenderness of Your compassion, the majesty of Your dominion and the perfection of Your holiness; the unconditioned light, by the secret of the withness that is not bounded; inward as meaning within Your unseen, and outward as truth within Your seen; the sun of the Lordly secrets, and the place of disclosure of the Presence of the Merciful Presences; the descending-places of the upright Books, the light of the clear signs — whom You created from the light of Your Essence and realised by Your Names and Attributes; from whose light You created the prophets and messengers; and to whom You made Yourself known by taking their covenant, in Your word, the True, the Manifest: ⟨ And when Allāh took the covenant of the prophets: whatever I have given you of Book and wisdom, then a Messenger comes to you confirming what is with you — you shall surely believe in him and surely help him. He said: do you affirm, and take up My burden upon that? They said: we affirm. He said: then bear witness, and I am with you among the witnesses. ⟩ O Allāh, bless and grant peace to the splendour of perfection, the crown of majesty, the radiance of beauty, the sun of union, the fragrance of existence and the life of every existing thing; the might of the majesty of Your sovereignty, the majesty of the might of Your kingdom, and the sovereign of the making of Your power; the embroidery of the choicest of the choice among the people of Your election, and the purest of the elect among the people of Your nearness; the greatest secret of Allāh, the most noble Beloved of Allāh, and the honoured intimate Friend of Allāh — our master and patron Muḥammad, may Allāh bless him and grant him peace
Tuesday وِرْدُ يَوْمِ الثُّلَاثَاءِ

اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنَّا نَتَوَسَّلُ بِهٖ إِلَيْكَ، وَنَتَشَفَّعُ بِهٖ لَدَيْكَ، صَاحِبِ الشَّفَاعَةِ الْكُبْرٰى، وَالْوَسِيْلَةِ الْعُظْمٰى، وَالشَّرِيْعَةِ الْغَرَّاءِ، وَالْمَكَانَةِ الْعُلْيَا، وَالْمَنْزِلَةِ الزُّلْفٰى، وَقَابَ قَوْسَيْنِ أَوْ أَدْنٰى، أَنْ تُحَقِّقَنَا بِهٖ ذَاتًا وَّصِفَاتًا وَّأَسْمَاۤءً وَّأَفْعَالًا وَّآثَارًا، حَتّٰى لَا نَرٰى وَلَا نَسْمَعَ وَلَا نُحِسَّ وَلَا نَجِدَ إِلَّا إِيَّاكَ ۝

Allāhumma innā natawassalu bihi ilayk, wa natashaffaʿu bihi ladayk — ṣāḥibi sh-shafāʿati l-kubrā, wa l-wasīlati l-ʿuẓmā, wa sh-sharīʿati l-gharrāʾ, wa l-makānati l-ʿulyā, wa l-manzilati z-zulfā, wa qāba qawsayni aw adnā — an tuḥaqqiqanā bihi dhātan wa ṣifātan wa asmāʾan wa afʿālan wa āthārā, ḥattā lā narā wa lā nasmaʿa wa lā nuḥissa wa lā najida illā iyyāk

O Allāh, we seek a means to You through him, and we seek his intercession with You — the possessor of the greatest intercession, the mightiest means of approach, the radiant sacred law, the highest place, the nearest station, and of two bows' length or nearer — that You realise us through him in essence, in attributes, in names, in acts and in traces, until we neither see nor hear nor sense nor find anything but You

إِلٰهِيْ وَسَيِّدِيْ بِفَضْلِكَ وَرَحْمَتِكَ، أَنْ تَجْعَلَ هُوِيَّتَنَا عَيْنَ هُوِيَّتِهٖ فِـيْ أَوَاۤئِلِهٖ وَنِهَايَتِهٖ بِوُدِّ خُلَّتِهٖ وَصَفَاۤءِ مَحَبَّتِهٖ وَفَوَاتِحِ أَنْوَارِ بَصِيْرَتِهٖ وَجَوَامِعِ أَسْرَارِ سَرِيْرَتِهٖ وَرَحِيْمِ رَحْمَاۤئِهٖ وَنَعِيْمِ نَعْمَاۤئِهٖ ۝

Ilāhī wa sayyidī, bi-faḍlika wa raḥmatik: an tajʿala huwiyyatanā ʿayna huwiyyatihi fī awāʾilihi wa nihāyatih, bi-wuddi khullatihi wa ṣafāʾi maḥabbatih, wa fawātiḥi anwāri baṣīratih, wa jawāmiʿi asrāri sarīratih, wa raḥīmi raḥmāʾih, wa naʿīmi naʿmāʾih

My God and my Master, by Your grace and Your mercy: make our identity the very identity of his, in its beginnings and its end — by the affection of his intimate friendship and the purity of his love, by the first openings of the lights of his inner sight and the sum of the secrets of his innermost being, by the tenderness of his mercies and the delight of his favours

اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ بِجَاهِ سَيِّدِنَا وَنَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ اَلْمَغْفِرَةَ وَالرِّضَا وَالْقَبُوْلَ، قَبُوْلًا تَامًّا، وَلَا تَكِلْنَا إِلَىٰ أَنْفُسِنَا طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ، يَا نِعْمَ الْمُجِيْبُ، فَقَدْ دَخَلَ الدَّخِيْلُ، يَا مَوْلَايَ، فَإِنَّ غُفْرَانَ ذُنُوْبِ الْخَلْقِ بِأَجْمَعِهِمْ، أَوَّلِهِمْ وَآخِرِهِمْ بَرِّهِمْ وَفَاجِرِهِمْ، كَقَطْرَةٍ فِـيْ بَحْرِ جُوْدِكَ الْوَاسِعِ الَّذِيْ لَا سَاحِلَ لَهٗ وَلَا غَايَةَ لَهٗ، فَقَدْ قُلْتَ وَقَوْلُكَ الْحَقُّ الْمُبِيْنُ: ﴿ وَمَاۤ أَرْسَلْنَاكَ إِلَّا رَحْمَةً لِّلْعَالَمِيْنَ۝ ﴾ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَىٰ آلِهٖ وَصَحْبِهٖ أَجْمَعِيْنَ ۝

Allāhumma innā nasʾaluka bi-jāhi sayyidinā wa nabiyyinā Muḥammadin ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam: al-maghfirata wa r-riḍā wa l-qabūl — qabūlan tāmman — wa lā takilnā ilā anfusinā ṭarfata ʿayn. Yā niʿma l-Mujīb, fa-qad dakhala d-dakhīl, yā Mawlāy; fa-inna ghufrāna dhunūbi l-khalqi bi-ajmaʿihim — awwalihim wa ākhirihim, barrihim wa fājirihim — ka-qaṭratin fī baḥri jūdika l-wāsiʿi lladhī lā sāḥila lahu wa lā ghāyata lah. Fa-qad qulta wa qawluka l-ḥaqqu l-mubīn: ⟨ wa mā arsalnāka illā raḥmatan li-l-ʿālamīn ⟩ — ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālihi wa ṣaḥbihi ajmaʿīn

O Allāh, we ask You by the standing of our master and prophet Muḥammad, may Allāh bless him and grant him peace: for forgiveness, good pleasure and acceptance — a complete acceptance — and do not entrust us to ourselves for the blink of an eye. O excellent Answerer, the seeker of refuge has entered, O my Patron; for the forgiving of the sins of all creation together — the first of them and the last, the righteous and the wicked — is as a drop in the sea of Your vast bounty, which has no shore and no end. For You have said, and Your word is the Truth, the Manifest: ⟨ and We sent you only as a mercy to the worlds ⟩ — may Allāh bless him and all his family and Companions

﴿ رَبِّ إِنِّـيْ وَهَنَ الْعَظْمُ مِنِّيْ وَاشْتَعَلَ الرَّأْسُ شَيْبًا وَّلَمْ أَكُنْۢ بِدُعَاۤئِكَ رَبِّ شَقِيًّا ۝ رَبِّ أَنِّـيْ مَسَّنِيَ الضُّرُّ وَأَنْتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ ۝ رَبِّ إِنِّـيْ لِمَاۤ أَنْزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيْرٌ۝ ﴾ يَا مُعِيْنَ الضُّعَفَاۤءِ، يَا عَظِيْمَ الرَّجَاءِ، يَا مُنْقِذَ الْغَرْقٰى، يَا مُنَجِّيَ الْهَلْكٰى، يَا نِعْمَ الْمَوْلٰى، يَا أَمَانَ الْخَاۤئِفِيْنَ، لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللهُ الْعَظِيْمُ الْحَلِيْمُ، لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيْمِ، لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللهُ رَبُّ السَّمٰوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيْمِ۝

⟨ Rabbi innī wahana l-ʿaẓmu minnī wa-shtaʿala r-raʾsu shayban wa lam akun bi-duʿāʾika Rabbi shaqiyyā. Rabbi annī massaniya ḍ-ḍurru wa anta Arḥamu r-rāḥimīn. Rabbi innī limā anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqīr. ⟩ Yā Muʿīna ḍ-ḍuʿafāʾ, yā ʿAẓīma r-rajāʾ, yā Munqidha l-gharqā, yā Munajjiya l-halkā, yā niʿma l-Mawlā, yā Amāna l-khāʾifīn. Lā ilāha illā llāhu l-ʿAẓīmu l-Ḥalīm; lā ilāha illā llāhu Rabbu l-ʿarshi l-ʿaẓīm; lā ilāha illā llāhu Rabbu s-samāwāti s-sabʿi wa Rabbu l-ʿarshi l-karīm

⟨ My Lord, the bone within me has grown feeble and the head is alight with grey, yet never, my Lord, have I been unblessed in calling upon You. My Lord, harm has touched me, and You are the Most Merciful of those who show mercy. My Lord, I am needy of whatever good You send down to me. ⟩ O Helper of the weak, O Great in what is hoped for, O Rescuer of the drowning, O Deliverer of the perishing, O excellent Patron, O Safety of the fearful. There is no god but Allāh, the Magnificent, the Forbearing; there is no god but Allāh, Lord of the Mighty Throne; there is no god but Allāh, Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the Noble Throne

اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَىٰ الْجَامِعِ الْأَكْمَلِ، وَالْقُطْبِ الرَّبَّانِـيِّ الْأَفْضَلِ، طِرَازِ حُلَّةِ الْإِيْمَانِ وَمَعْدِنِ الْجُوْدِ وَالْإِحْسَانِ صَاحِبِ الْهِمَمِ السَّمَاوِيَّةِ وَالْعُلُوْمِ اللَّدُنِّيَّةِ ۝
Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim ʿalā l-jāmiʿi l-akmal, wa l-quṭbi r-rabbāniyyi l-afḍal, ṭirāzi ḥullati l-īmāni wa maʿdini l-jūdi wa l-iḥsān, ṣāḥibi l-himami s-samāwiyyati wa l-ʿulūmi l-ladunniyya

O Allāh, bless and grant peace to the most perfect gatherer, the most excellent Lordly Quṭb, the embroidery of the robe of faith and the mine of bounty and beneficence, possessor of heavenly aspirations and of the knowledge that is from His presence

اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَىٰ مَنْ خَلَقْتَ الْوُجُوْدَ لِأَجْلِهٖ وَرَخَّصْتَ الْأَشْيَاۤءَ بِسَبَبِهٖ، مُحَمَّدِ الْمَحْمُوْدِ، صَاحِبِ الْمَكَارِمِ وَالْجُوْدِ، وَعَلَىٰ آلِهٖ وَأَصْحَابِهِ الْأَقْطَابِ السَّابِقِيْنَ إِلَىٰ جَنَابِ ذٰلِكَ الْجَنَابِ ۝

Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim ʿalā man khalaqta l-wujūda li-ajlih, wa rakhkhaṣta l-ashyāʾa bi-sababih — Muḥammadin al-maḥmūd, ṣāḥibi l-makārimi wa l-jūd — wa ʿalā ālihi wa aṣḥābihi l-aqṭābi s-sābiqīna ilā janābi dhālika l-janāb

O Allāh, bless and grant peace to him for whose sake You created existence, and on whose account You made all things permissible — Muḥammad the praised, possessor of noble qualities and bounty — and upon his family and his Companions, the aqṭāb who were foremost in reaching that Presence

اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَىٰ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ، اَلنُّوْرِ الْبَهِيِّ وَالْبَيَانِ الْجَلِيِّ وَاللِّسَانِ الْعَرَبِـيِّ وَالدِّيْنِ الْحَنِيْفِيِّ، اَلرَّحْمَةِ لِلْعَالَمِيْنَ، اَلْمُؤَيَّدِ بِالرُّوْحِ الْأَمِيْنِ وَالْكِتَابِ الْمُبِيْنِ، وَخَاتَمِ النَّبِيِّيْنَ وَرَحْمَةِ اللهِ لِلْعَالَمِيْنَ وَالْخَلَائِقِ أَجْمَعِيْنَ ۝

Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammad — an-nūri l-bahiyy, wa l-bayāni l-jaliyy, wa l-lisāni l-ʿarabiyy, wa d-dīni l-ḥanīfiyy; ar-raḥmati li-l-ʿālamīn; al-muʾayyadi bi-r-Rūḥi l-Amīni wa l-Kitābi l-Mubīn; wa khātami n-nabiyyīna wa raḥmati llāhi li-l-ʿālamīna wa l-khalāʾiqi ajmaʿīn

O Allāh, bless and grant peace to our master Muḥammad — the resplendent light, the manifest exposition, the Arabic tongue and the ḥanīf religion; the mercy to the worlds; supported by the Trustworthy Spirit and the Manifest Book; the Seal of the Prophets and the mercy of Allāh to the worlds and to all creatures

اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَىٰ مَنْ خَلَقْتَهٗ مِنْ نُّوْرِكَ وَجَعَلْتَ كَلَامَهٗ مِنْ كَلَامِكَ وَفَضَّلْتَهٗ عَلَىٰ أَنْۢبِيَاۤئِكَ وَأَوْلِيَاۤئِكَ وَجَعَلْتَ السِّعَايَةَ مِنْكَ إِلَيْهِ وَمِنْهُ إِلَيْهِمْ، كَمَالِ كُلِّ وَلِـيٍّ لَّكَ، وَهَادِيْ كُلِّ مُضِلٍّ عَنْكَ، هَادِي الْخَلْقِ إِلَى الْحَقِّ، تَارِكِ الْأَشْيَاءِ لِأَجْلِكَ وَمَعْدِنِ الْخَيْرَاتِ بِفَضْلِكَ، وَمَنْ خَاطَبْتَهٗ عَلَىٰ بِسَاطِ قُرْبِكَ ﴿ وَكَانَ فَضْلُ اللهِ عَلَيْكَ عَظِيْمًا۝ ﴾ اَلْقَاۤئِمِ لَكَ فِـيْ لَيْلِكَ وَالصَّاۤئِمِ لَكَ فِـيْ نَهَارِكَ وَالْهَاۤئِمِ بِكَ فِـيْ جَلَالِكَ ۝

Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim ʿalā man khalaqtahu min nūrik, wa jaʿalta kalāmahu min kalāmik, wa faḍḍaltahu ʿalā anbiyāʾika wa awliyāʾik, wa jaʿalta s-siʿāyata minka ilayhi wa minhu ilayhim — kamāli kulli waliyyin lak, wa hādī kulli muḍillin ʿank; hādī l-khalqi ilā l-Ḥaqq; tāriki l-ashyāʾi li-ajlik, wa maʿdini l-khayrāti bi-faḍlik; wa man khāṭabtahu ʿalā bisāṭi qurbik: ⟨ wa kāna faḍlu llāhi ʿalayka ʿaẓīmā ⟩ — al-qāʾimi laka fī laylik, wa ṣ-ṣāʾimi laka fī nahārik, wa l-hāʾimi bika fī jalālik

O Allāh, bless and grant peace to him whom You created from Your light, whose speech You made from Your speech, whom You favoured above Your prophets and Your friends, and through whom You made the striving pass from You to him and from him to them — the perfection of every friend of Yours, and the guide of everyone who led astray from You; the guide of creation to the Real; who left all things for Your sake, and the mine of good things by Your grace; and whom You addressed upon the carpet of Your nearness: ⟨ and the grace of Allāh upon you has been immense ⟩ — who stood for You in Your night, and fasted for You in Your day, and was rapt with You in Your majesty

اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَىٰ نَبِيِّكَ الْخَلِيْفَةِ فِـيْ خَلْقِكَ، اَلْمُشْتَغِلِ بِذِكْرِكَ، اَلْمُتَفَكِّرِ فِـيْ خَلْقِكَ، وَالْأَمِيْنِ لِسِرِّكَ، وَالْبُرْهَانِ لِرُسُلِكَ، اَلْحَاضِرِ فِـيْ سَرَاۤئِرِ قُدْسِكَ، وَالْمُشَاهِدِ لِجَمَالِ جَلَالِكَ، سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ، اَلْمُفَسِّرِ لِآيَاتِكَ، وَالظَّاهِرِ فِـيْ مُلْكِكَ، وَالنَّائِبِ فِـيْ مَلَكُوْتِكَ، وَالْمُتَخَلِّقِ بِصِفَاتِكَ، وَالدَّاعِيْ إِلَىٰ جَبَرُوْتِكَ، اَلْحَضْرَةِ الرَّحْمَانِيَّةِ، وَالْبُرْدَةِ الْجَلَالِيَّةِ، وَالسَّرَابِيْلِ الْجَمَالِيّةِ، اَلْعَرِيْشِ السَّقِيِّ، وَالْحَبِيْبِ النَّبَوِيِّ، وَالنُّوْرِ الْبَهِيِّ، وَالدُّرِّ النَّقِيِّ، وَالْمِصْبَاحِ الْقَوِيِّ ۝

Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim ʿalā nabiyyika l-khalīfati fī khalqik; al-mushtaghili bi-dhikrik, al-mutafakkiri fī khalqik, wa l-amīni li-sirrik, wa l-burhāni li-rusulik; al-ḥāḍiri fī sarāʾiri qudsik, wa l-mushāhidi li-jamāli jalālik — sayyidinā wa mawlānā Muḥammad; al-mufassiri li-āyātik, wa ẓ-ẓāhiri fī mulkik, wa n-nāʾibi fī malakūtik, wa l-mutakhalliqi bi-ṣifātik, wa d-dāʿī ilā jabarūtik; al-ḥaḍrati r-raḥmāniyya, wa l-burdati l-jalāliyya, wa s-sarābīli l-jamāliyya; al-ʿarīshi s-saqiyy, wa l-Ḥabībi n-nabawiyy, wa n-nūri l-bahiyy, wa d-durri n-naqiyy, wa l-miṣbāḥi l-qawiyy

O Allāh, bless and grant peace to Your prophet, the vicegerent among Your creation; occupied with Your remembrance, contemplating Your creation, the trustee of Your secret and the proof of Your messengers; present within the inmost recesses of Your holiness, and beholding the beauty of Your majesty — our master and patron Muḥammad; the expounder of Your signs, the manifest one in Your dominion, the deputy in Your unseen kingdom, formed by Your attributes, and the caller to Your compelling power; the Merciful Presence, the mantle of majesty and the robes of beauty; the watered bower, the Prophetic Beloved, the resplendent light, the unsullied pearl and the powerful lamp
اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَىٰ آلِهٖ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَىٰ إِبْرَاهِيْمَ وَآلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيْدٌ مَّجِيْدٌ۝
Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālihi kamā ṣallayta ʿalā Ibrāhīma wa āli Ibrāhīm; innaka Ḥamīdun Majīd
O Allāh, bless and grant peace to him and to his family as You blessed Ibrāhīm and the family of Ibrāhīm; truly You are Praiseworthy, Glorious
Wednesday وِرْدُ يَوْمِ الْأَرْبَعَاءِ

اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَىٰ سَيِّدِنَا وَنَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ، بَحْرِ أَنْوَارِكَ وَمَعْدِنِ أَسْرَارِكَ وَرُوْحِ أَرْوَاحِ عِبَادِكَ، اَلدُّرَّةِ الْفَاخِرَةِ وَالْعَبَقَةِ النَّافِحَةِ، بُؤْبُؤِ الْمَوْجُوْدَاتِ وَحَآءِ الرَّحَمَاتِ وَجِيْمِ الدَّرَجَاتِ وَسِيْنِ السَّعَادَاتِ وَنُوْنِ الْعِنَايَاتِ وَكَمَالِ الْكُلِّيَّاتِ وَمَنْشَإِ الْأَزَلِيَّاتِ وَخَتْمِ الْأَبَدِيَّاتِ، اَلْمَشْغُوْلِ بِكَ عَنِ الْأَشْيَاۤءِ الدُّنْيَوِيَّاتِ، اَلطَّاعِمِ مِنْ ثَمَرَاتِ الْمُشَاهَدَاتِ وَالْمُسْقٰى مِنْ أَسْرَارِ الْقُدْسِيَّاتِ، اَلْعَالِمِ بِالْمَاضِيْ وَالْمُسْتَقْبَلَاتِ، سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ، وَعَلَىٰ آلِهِ الْأَبْرَارِ، وَأَصْحَابِهِ الْأَخْيَارِ۝

Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim ʿalā sayyidinā wa nabiyyinā Muḥammad — baḥri anwārika wa maʿdini asrārika wa rūḥi arwāḥi ʿibādik; ad-durrati l-fākhirati wa l-ʿabaqati n-nāfiḥa; buʾbuʾi l-mawjūdāt, wa ḥāʾi r-raḥamāt, wa jīmi d-darajāt, wa sīni s-saʿādāt, wa nūni l-ʿināyāt, wa kamāli l-kulliyyāt, wa manshaʾi l-azaliyyāt, wa khatmi l-abadiyyāt; al-mashghūli bika ʿani l-ashyāʾi d-dunyawiyyāt; aṭ-ṭāʿimi min thamarāti l-mushāhadāt, wa l-musqā min asrāri l-qudsiyyāt; al-ʿālimi bi-l-māḍī wa l-mustaqbalāt — sayyidinā wa mawlānā Muḥammad — wa ʿalā ālihi l-abrār, wa aṣḥābihi l-akhyār

O Allāh, bless and grant peace to our master and our prophet Muḥammad — the sea of Your lights, the mine of Your secrets and the spirit of the spirits of Your servants; the precious pearl and the diffusing fragrance; the pupil of the eye of all existing things; the ḥāʾ of mercies, the jīm of degrees, the sīn of felicities and the nūn of solicitudes; the perfection of universals, the origin of pre-eternal things and the seal of everlasting ones; occupied with You away from the things of this world; who tastes the fruits of direct witnessings and is given to drink of the holy secrets; who knows what is past and what is to come — our master and patron Muḥammad — and upon his righteous family and his excellent Companions

اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَىٰ رُوْحِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِـي الْأَرْوَاحِ وَعَلَىٰ جَسَدِهٖ فِـي الَأَجْسَادِ وَعَلَىٰ قَبْرِهٖ فِـي الْقُبُوْرِ وَعَلَىٰ أَسْمَآئِهٖ فِـي الْأَسْمَآءِ وَعَلَىٰ قَلْبِهٖ فِـي الْقُلُوْبِ وَعَلَىٰ مَنْظَرِهٖ فِـي الْمَنَاظِرِ وَعَلَىٰ سَمْعِهٖ فِـي الْمَسَامِعِ وَعَلَىٰ حَرَكَتِهٖ فِـي الْحَرَكَاتِ وَعَلَىٰ سُكُوْنِهٖ فِـي السَّكَنَاتِ وَعَلَىٰ قُعُوْدِهٖ فِـي الْقُعُوْدَاتِ وَعَلَىٰ قِيَامِهٖ فِـي الْقِيَامَاتِ وَعَلَىٰ لِسَانِهِ الْبَشَّاشِ الْأَزَلِـيِّ وَالْخَتْمِ الْأَبَدِيِّ ۝

Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim ʿalā rūḥi sayyidinā Muḥammadin fī l-arwāḥ, wa ʿalā jasadihi fī l-ajsād, wa ʿalā qabrihi fī l-qubūr, wa ʿalā asmāʾihi fī l-asmāʾ, wa ʿalā qalbihi fī l-qulūb, wa ʿalā manẓarihi fī l-manāẓir, wa ʿalā samʿihi fī l-masāmiʿ, wa ʿalā ḥarakatihi fī l-ḥarakāt, wa ʿalā sukūnihi fī s-sakanāt, wa ʿalā quʿūdihi fī l-quʿūdāt, wa ʿalā qiyāmihi fī l-qiyāmāt, wa ʿalā lisānihi l-bashshāshi l-azaliyyi wa l-khatmi l-abadiyy

O Allāh, bless and grant peace to the spirit of our master Muḥammad among the spirits, and to his body among bodies, and to his grave among the graves, and to his names among names, and to his heart among hearts, and to his aspect among aspects, and to his hearing among all hearing, and to his movement among movements, and to his stillness among stillnesses, and to his sitting among all sitting, and to his standing among all standing, and to his tongue, radiant from pre-eternity and sealed unto everlastingness
وَصَلِّ اللّٰهُمَّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَىٰ آلِهٖ وَأَصْحَابِهٖ عَدَدَ مَا عَلِمْتَ وَمِلْءَ مَا عَلِمْتَ ۝
Wa ṣalli, Allāhumma, wa sallim ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālihi wa aṣḥābihi ʿadada mā ʿalimta wa milʾa mā ʿalimt
And bless, O Allāh, and grant peace to him and to his family and his Companions, by the number of what You know and the fullness of what You know

اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَىٰ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ، اَلَّذِيْ أَعْطَيْتَهٗ وَكَرَّمْتَهٗ وَفَضَّلْتَهٗ وَنَصَرْتَهٗ وَأَعَنْتَهٗ وَقَرَّبْتَهٗ وَأَدْنَيْتَهٗ وَسَقَيْتَهٗ وَمَكَّنْتَهٗ وَمَلَأْتَهٗ بِعِلْمِكَ الْأَنْفَسِ وَبَسَطْتَهٗ بِحِلْمِكَ الْأَطْرَسِ وَحُبِّكَ الْأَطْوَسِ، وَزَيَّنْتَهٗ بِقَوْلِكَ الْأَقْبَسِ، فَخْرِ الْأَفْلَاكِ وَعَذْبِ الْأَخْلَاقِ وَنُوْرِكَ الْمُبِيْنِ وَعَبْدِكَ الْقَدِيْمِ وَحَبْلِكَ الْمَتِيْنِ وَحِصْنِكَ الْحَصِيْنِ وَجَلَالِكَ الْحَكِيْمِ وَجَمَالِكَ الْكَرِيْمِ، سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَّعَلَىٰ آلِهٖ وَأَصْحَابِهٖ مَصَابِيْحِ الْهُدٰى وَقَنَادِيْلِ الْوُجُوْدِ وَكَمَالِ السُّعُوْدِ، اَلْمُطَهَّرِيْنَ مِنَ الْعُيُوْبِ ۝

Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammad — alladhī aʿṭaytahu wa karramtahu wa faḍḍaltahu wa naṣartahu wa aʿantahu wa qarrabtahu wa adnaytahu wa saqaytahu wa makkantahu wa malaʾtahu bi-ʿilmika l-anfas, wa basaṭtahu bi-ḥilmika l-aṭras wa ḥubbika l-aṭwas, wa zayyantahu bi-qawlika l-aqbas; fakhri l-aflāki wa ʿadhbi l-akhlāq, wa nūrika l-mubīn, wa ʿabdika l-qadīm, wa ḥablika l-matīn, wa ḥiṣnika l-ḥaṣīn, wa jalālika l-ḥakīm, wa jamālika l-karīm — sayyidinā wa mawlānā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā ālihi wa aṣḥābihi maṣābīḥi l-hudā wa qanādīli l-wujūdi wa kamāli s-suʿūd, al-muṭahharīna mina l-ʿuyūb

O Allāh, bless and grant peace to our master Muḥammad — whom You gave and honoured and favoured, whom You helped and aided, whom You drew near and brought close, whom You gave to drink and established, and whom You filled with Your most precious knowledge; whom You expanded by Your unblemished forbearance and Your most radiant love, and adorned with Your kindling speech; the pride of the spheres and the sweetness of character; Your manifest light, Your ancient servant, Your firm rope, Your impregnable fortress, Your wise majesty and Your generous beauty — our master and patron Muḥammad, and upon his family and his Companions, the lamps of guidance and the lanterns of existence and the perfection of good fortune, purified of all faults
اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَيْهِ صَلَاةً تَحُلُّ بِهَا الْعُقَدُ وَرِيْحًا تَفُكُّ بِهَا الْكُرَبُ وَتَرَحُّمًا تُزِيْلُ بِهَا الْعَطَبُ وَتَكْرِيْمًا تُقْضٰى بِهِ الْأَرَبُ ۝
Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim ʿalayhi ṣalātan taḥullu bihā l-ʿuqad, wa rīḥan tafukku bihā l-kurab, wa taraḥḥuman tuzīlu bihā l-ʿaṭab, wa takrīman tuqḍā bihi l-arab

O Allāh, bless and grant him peace with a blessing by which knots are untied, and a breath by which distresses are loosed, and a compassion by which ruin is removed, and an honouring by which every need is met
يَا رَبُّ، يَا اَللهُ يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّوْمُ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ، نَسْأَلُكَ ذٰلِكَ مِنْ فَضَاۤئِلِ لُطْفِكَ وَغَرَاۤئِبِ فَضْلِكَ يَا كَرِيْمُ يَا رَحِيْمُ۝
Yā Rabb, yā Allāh, yā Ḥayyu, yā Qayyūm, yā Dhā l-jalāli wa l-ikrām: nasʾaluka dhālika min faḍāʾili luṭfika wa gharāʾibi faḍlik, yā Karīmu yā Raḥīm
O Lord, O Allāh, O Living, O Self-Subsisting, O Possessor of majesty and honour: we ask You for that, out of the excellences of Your gentleness and the wonders of Your grace, O Generous, O Merciful

اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَىٰ عَبْدِك وَنَبِيِّك وَرَسُوْلِكَ، سَيِّدِنَا وَنَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدِ النَّبِيِّ الْأُمِّيِّ، وَالرَّسُوْلِ الْعَرَبِـيِّ، وَعَلَىٰ آلِهٖ وَأَصْحَابِهٖ وَأَزْوَاجِهٖ وَذُرِّيَّاتِهٖ وَأَهْلِ بَيْتِهٖ صَلَاةً تَكُوْنُ لَكَ رِضَاۤءً وَّلَهٗ جَزَاۤءً وَّلِحَقِّهٖ أَدَاۤءً وَّأَعْطِهِ الْوَسِيْلَةَ وَالْفَضِيْلَةَ وَالشَّرَفَ وَالدَّرَجَةَ الْعَالِيَةَ الرَّفِيْعَةَ وَابْعَثْهُ الْمَقَامَ الْمَحْمُوْدَ الَّذِيْ وَعَدْتَهٗ، يَاۤ أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ ۝

Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim ʿalā ʿabdika wa nabiyyika wa rasūlik — sayyidinā wa nabiyyinā Muḥammadin an-nabiyyi l-ummiyyi wa r-rasūli l-ʿarabiyy — wa ʿalā ālihi wa aṣḥābihi wa azwājihi wa dhurriyyātihi wa ahli baytihi ṣalātan takūnu laka riḍāʾan wa lahu jazāʾan wa li-ḥaqqihi adāʾā; wa aʿṭihi l-wasīlata wa l-faḍīlata wa sh-sharafa wa d-darajata l-ʿāliyata r-rafīʿa; wa-bʿathhu l-maqāma l-maḥmūda lladhī waʿadtahu, yā Arḥama r-rāḥimīn

O Allāh, bless and grant peace to Your servant, Your prophet and Your messenger — our master and our prophet Muḥammad, the unlettered Prophet and Arab Messenger — and to his family, his Companions, his wives, his descendants and the people of his house: a blessing that is Your good pleasure, and his recompense, and the discharge of what is due to him. And give him the means of approach, the excellence, the honour and the lofty exalted degree; and raise him to the Praiseworthy Station You promised him, O Most Merciful of those who show mercy

اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنَّا نَتَوَسَّلُ بِكَ وَنَسْأَلُكَ وَنَتَوَجَّهُ إِلَيْكَ بِكِتَابِكَ الْعَزِيْزِ وَبِنَبِيِّكَ الْكَرِيْمِ، سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَبِشَرَفِهِ الْمَجِيْدِ وَبِأَبَوَيْهِ إِبْرَاهِيْمَ وَإِسْمَاعِيْلَ، وَبِصَاحِبَيْهِ أَبِـيْ بَكْرٍ وَّعُمَرَ، وَصِهْرِهٖ ذِي النُّوْرَيْنِ عُثْمَانَ، وَآلِهٖ فَاطِمَةَ وَعَلِيٍّ، وَّوَلَدَيْهِمَا السِّبْطَيْنِ الْحَسَنِ وَالْحُسَيْنِ، وَعَمَّيْهِ الْحَمْزَةَ وَالْعَبَّاسَ، وَزَوْجَتَيْهِ خَدِيْجَةَ وَعَاۤئِشَةَ رِضْوَانُ اللّٰهِ تَعَالٰى عَلَيْهِمْ أَجْمَعِيْنَ ۝

Allāhumma innā natawassalu bika wa nasʾaluka wa natawajjahu ilayka bi-kitābika l-ʿazīz, wa bi-nabiyyika l-karīm sayyidinā Muḥammadin ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam, wa bi-sharafihi l-majīd; wa bi-abawayhi Ibrāhīma wa Ismāʿīl; wa bi-ṣāḥibayhi Abī Bakrin wa ʿUmar; wa ṣihrihi Dhī n-Nūrayni ʿUthmān; wa ālihi Fāṭimata wa ʿAliyy; wa waladayhimā s-sibṭayni l-Ḥasani wa l-Ḥusayn; wa ʿammayhi l-Ḥamzata wa l-ʿAbbās; wa zawjatayhi Khadījata wa ʿĀʾisha — riḍwānu llāhi taʿālā ʿalayhim ajmaʿīn

O Allāh, we seek a means through You, and ask of You, and turn toward You by Your mighty Book, and by Your noble Prophet, our master Muḥammad, may Allāh bless him and grant him peace, and by his glorious honour; and by his two forefathers Ibrāhīm and Ismāʿīl; and by his two Companions Abū Bakr and ʿUmar; and by his son-in-law, the Possessor of the Two Lights, ʿUthmān; and by his family, Fāṭima and ʿAlī; and by their two sons, the two grandsons, al-Ḥasan and al-Ḥusayn; and by his two uncles, Ḥamza and al-ʿAbbās; and by his two wives, Khadīja and ʿĀʾisha — the good pleasure of Allāh Most High be upon them all

اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَىٰ أَبَوَيْهِ إِبْرَاهِيْمَ وَإِسْمَاعِيْلَ وَعَلَىٰ آلِ كُلٍّ وَّصَحْبِ كُلٍّ، صَلَاةً يُتَرْجِمُهَا لِسَانُ الْأَزَلِ فِـيْ رِيَاضِ الْمَلَكُوْتِ وَعُلُوِّ الْمَقَامَاتِ وَنَيْلِ الْكَرَامَاتِ وَرَفْعِ الدَّرَجَاتِ وَيَنْطِقُ بِهَا لِسَانُ الْأَبَدِ فِـيْ حَضِيْضِ النَّاسُوْتِ لِغُفْرَانِ الذُّنُوْبِ وَكَشْفِ الْكُرُوْبِ وَدَفْعِ الْمُهِمَّاتِ كَمَا هُوَ اللَّائِقُ بِإِلٰهِيَّتِكَ وَشَأْنِكَ الْعَظِيْمِ، وَكَمَا هُوَ اللَّائِقُ بِأَهْلِيَّتِهِمْ وَمَنْصِبِهِمُ الْكَرِيْمِ بِخُصُوْصِ خَصَاۤئِصِ: ﴿ وَاللهُ يَخْتَصُّ بِرَحْمَتِهٖ مَنْ يَّشَآءُؕ وَاللهُ ذُو الْفَضْلِ الْعَظِيْمِ۝ ﴾

Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim ʿalayhi wa ʿalā abawayhi Ibrāhīma wa Ismāʿīl, wa ʿalā āli kullin wa ṣaḥbi kull — ṣalātan yutarjimuhā lisānu l-azali fī riyāḍi l-malakūti wa ʿuluwwi l-maqāmāti wa nayli l-karāmāti wa rafʿi d-darajāt; wa yanṭiqu bihā lisānu l-abadi fī ḥaḍīḍi n-nāsūti li-ghufrāni dh-dhunūbi wa kashfi l-kurūbi wa dafʿi l-muhimmāt — kamā huwa l-lāʾiqu bi-ilāhiyyatika wa shaʾnika l-ʿaẓīm, wa kamā huwa l-lāʾiqu bi-ahliyyatihim wa manṣibihimu l-karīm, bi-khuṣūṣi khaṣāʾiṣi: ⟨ wa llāhu yakhtaṣṣu bi-raḥmatihi man yashāʾ, wa llāhu Dhū l-faḍli l-ʿaẓīm ⟩

O Allāh, bless and grant peace to him and to his two forefathers Ibrāhīm and Ismāʿīl, and to the family of each and the Companions of each — a blessing that the tongue of pre-eternity interprets in the gardens of the unseen kingdom, in the loftiness of the stations, the attaining of miracles and the raising of degrees; and that the tongue of everlastingness utters in the lowlands of the human world, for the forgiving of sins, the lifting of afflictions and the repelling of grave matters — as befits Your divinity and Your immense majesty, and as befits their worthiness and their noble rank, by the particular property of: ⟨ and Allāh singles out for His mercy whom He wills, and Allāh is the Possessor of immense grace ⟩
Thursday وِرْدُ يَوْمِ الْخَمِيْسِ

اَللّٰهُمَّ حَقِّقْنَا بِسَرَاۤئِرِهِمْ فِـيْ مَدَارِجِ مَعَارِفِهِمْ بِمَثُوْبَةِ الَّذِيْنَ سَبَقَتْ لَهُمْ مِّنْكَ الْحُسْنٰى، آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَالْفَوْزَ بِالسَّعَادَةِ الْكُبْرٰى بِمَوَدَّتِهِ الْقُرْبٰى، وَعُمَّنَا فِـيْ عِزِّهِ الْمَصْمُوْدِ فِـيْ مَقَامِهِ الْمَحْمُوْدِ وَتَحْتَ لِوَاۤئِهِ الْمَعْقُوْدِ، وَاسْقِنَا مِنْ حَوْضِ عِرْفَانِ مَعْرُوْفِهِ الْمَوْرُوْدِ، ﴿ يَوْمَ لَا يُخْزِي اللهُ النَّبِيَّ، ﴾ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، بِبُرُوْزِ بِشَارَةِ، قُلْ تُسْمَعْ، وَسَلْ تُعْطَ، وَاشْفَعْ تُشَفَّعْ، بِظُهُوْرِ بِشَارَةِ ﴿ وَلَسَوْفَ يُعْطِيْكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرْضٰى۝ ﴾ تَبَارَكْتَ وَتَعَالَيْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ۝

Allāhumma ḥaqqiqnā bi-sarāʾirihim fī madāriji maʿārifihim bi-mathūbati lladhīna sabaqat lahum minka l-ḥusnā — āli Muḥammadin ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam — wa l-fawza bi-s-saʿādati l-kubrā bi-mawaddatihi l-qurbā; wa ʿummanā fī ʿizzihi l-maṣmūdi fī maqāmihi l-maḥmūdi wa taḥta liwāʾihi l-maʿqūd; wa-sqinā min ḥawḍi ʿirfāni maʿrūfihi l-mawrūd ⟨ yawma lā yukhzī llāhu n-Nabiyy ⟩ — ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam — bi-burūzi bishārati “qul tusmaʿ, wa sal tuʿṭa, wa-shfaʿ tushaffaʿ”, bi-ẓuhūri bishārati ⟨ wa la-sawfa yuʿṭīka rabbuka fa-tarḍā ⟩ . Tabārakta wa taʿālayta yā Dhā l-jalāli wa l-ikrām

O Allāh, realise us through their inmost secrets in the ascending stages of their knowledge, by the recompense of those for whom the most beautiful reward has gone forth from You — the family of Muḥammad, may Allāh bless him and grant him peace — and by triumph in the greatest felicity through love of his near kin. Encompass us in his sought-after might, in his Praiseworthy Station and beneath his appointed banner; and give us to drink from the Basin of the gnosis of his known bounty, to which they come, ⟨ on the Day when Allāh will not disgrace the Prophet ⟩ — may Allāh bless him and grant him peace — by the emergence of the glad tiding “speak and you shall be heard, ask and you shall be given, intercede and your intercession shall be accepted”, and by the appearing of the glad tiding ⟨ and your Lord shall surely give to you, and you shall be well pleased ⟩ . Blessed and exalted are You, O Possessor of majesty and honour

اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنَّا نَعُوْذُ بِعِزِّ جَلَالِكَ وَبِجَلَالِ عِزَّتِكَ وَبِقُدْرَةِ سُلْطَانِكَ وَبِسُلْطَانِ قُدْرَتِكَ وَبِحُبِّ نَبِيِّكَ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مِنَ الْقَطِيْعَةِ وَالْأَهْوَاۤءِ الرَّدِيَّةِ يَا ظَهِيْرَ اللَّاجِئِيْنَ، يَا جَارَ الْمُسْتَجِيْرِيْنَ، أَجِرْنَا مِنَ الْخَوَاطِرِ النَّفْسَانِيَّةِ وَاحْفَظْنَا مِنَ الشَّهَوَاتِ الشَّيْطَانِيَّةِ وَطَهِّرْنَا مِنْ قَاذُوْرَاتِ الْبَشَرِيَّةِ وَصَفِّنَا بِصَفَاۤءِ الْمَحَبَّةِ الصِّدِّيْقِيَّةِ مِنْ صَدَإِ الْغَفْلَةِ وَوَهْمِ الْجَهْلِ، حَتّٰى تَضْمَحِلَّ رُسُوْمُنَا بِفَنَاءِ الْأَنَانِيَّةِ وَمُبَايَنَةِ الطَّبِيْعَةِ الْإِنْسَانِيَّةِ فِـيْ حَضْرَةِ الْجَمْعِ وَالتَّخْلِيَّةِ وَالتَّحَلِّيْ بِالْأُلُوْهِيَّةِ الْأَحَدِيَّةِ وَالتَّجَلِّيْ بِالْحَقَاۤئِقِ الصَّمَدَانِيَّةِ فِـيْ شُهُوْدِ الْوَحْدَانِيَّةِ، حَيْثُ لَا حَيْثُ وَلَا أَيْنَ وَلَا كَيْفَ، وَيَبْقَى الْكُلُّ لِلّٰهِ، وَبِاللهِ، وَمِنَ اللهِ، وَإِلَى اللهِ، وَمَعَ اللهِ، غَرِقًاۢ بِنِعْمَةِ اللهِ فِـيْ بَحْرِ مِنَّةِ اللهِ، مَنْصُوْرِيْنَ بِسَيْفِ اللهِ، مَخْصُوْصِيْنَ بِمَكَارِمِ اللّٰهِ، مَلْحُوْظِيْنَ بِعَيْنِ اللّٰهِ، مَحْظُوْظِيْنَ بِعِنَايَةِ اللهِ، مَحْفُوْظِيْنَ بِعِصْمَةِ اللهِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَاغِلٍ يَّشْغَلُ عَنِ اللهِ، وَخَاطِرٍ يَّخْطُرُ بِغَيْرِ اللهِ، يَا رَبِّ يَا اَللهُ، يَا رَبِّ يَا اَللهُ، يَا رَبِّ يَا اَللهُ، رَبِّـيَ اللهُ، وَمَا تَوْفِيْقِيْ إِلَّا بِاللهِ، عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَإِلَيْهِ اُنِيْبُ ۝

Allāhumma innā naʿūdhu bi-ʿizzi jalālika wa bi-jalāli ʿizzatika wa bi-qudrati sulṭānika wa bi-sulṭāni qudratika wa bi-ḥubbi nabiyyika Muḥammadin ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam — mina l-qaṭīʿati wa l-ahwāʾi r-radiyya. Yā Ẓahīra l-lājiʾīn, yā Jāra l-mustajīrīn: ajirnā mina l-khawāṭiri n-nafsāniyya, wa-ḥfaẓnā mina sh-shahawāti sh-shayṭāniyya, wa ṭahhirnā min qādhūrāti l-bashariyya, wa ṣaffinā bi-ṣafāʾi l-maḥabbati ṣ-ṣiddīqiyyati min ṣadaʾi l-ghaflati wa wahmi l-jahl — ḥattā taḍmaḥilla rusūmunā bi-fanāʾi l-anāniyyati wa mubāyanati ṭ-ṭabīʿati l-insāniyya, fī ḥaḍrati l-jamʿi wa t-takhliyati wa t-taḥallī bi-l-ulūhiyyati l-aḥadiyya, wa t-tajallī bi-l-ḥaqāʾiqi ṣ-ṣamadāniyyati fī shuhūdi l-waḥdāniyya — ḥaythu lā ḥaythu wa lā ayna wa lā kayf. Wa yabqā l-kullu li-llāh, wa bi-llāh, wa mina llāh, wa ilā llāh, wa maʿa llāh — gharqan bi-niʿmati llāhi fī baḥri minnati llāh; manṣūrīna bi-sayfi llāh, makhṣūṣīna bi-makārimi llāh, malḥūẓīna bi-ʿayni llāh, maḥẓūẓīna bi-ʿināyati llāh, maḥfūẓīna bi-ʿiṣmati llāhi min kulli shāghilin yashghalu ʿani llāh, wa khāṭirin yakhṭuru bi-ghayri llāh. Yā Rabbi yā Allāh — three times — Rabbiya llāh; wa mā tawfīqī illā bi-llāh, ʿalayhi tawakkaltu wa ilayhi unīb

O Allāh, we take refuge in the might of Your majesty and the majesty of Your might, in the power of Your sovereignty and the sovereignty of Your power, and in love of Your prophet Muḥammad, may Allāh bless him and grant him peace — from severance and from base desires. O Support of those who take shelter, O Protector of those who seek protection: shelter us from the promptings of the lower soul, and guard us from satanic appetites, and purify us from the defilements of human nature, and refine us with the purity of the love of the truthful ones, from the rust of heedlessness and the illusion of ignorance — until our traces dissolve in the passing away of self-assertion and the parting from human nature, in the Presence of gathering, of divestment and of investiture with the divine oneness, and of self-disclosure by the realities of the Eternally Besought in the witnessing of unity — where there is no where, no place and no how. And all remains for Allāh, by Allāh, from Allāh, to Allāh and with Allāh — drowned in the blessing of Allāh within the sea of the favour of Allāh; given victory by the sword of Allāh, singled out by the noble qualities of Allāh, regarded by the eye of Allāh, favoured by the solicitude of Allāh, guarded by the protection of Allāh from every distraction that distracts from Allāh, and from every thought that occurs by other than Allāh. O my Lord, O Allāh — three times — my Lord is Allāh; and my success is only by Allāh; in Him I trust and to Him I turn

اَللّٰهُمَّ اشْغَلْنَا بِكَ وَهَبْ لَنَا هِبَةً لَّا سَعَةَ فِيْهَا لِغَيْرِكَ وَلَا مَدْخَلَ فِيْهَا لِسِوَاكَ، وَاسِعَةًۢ بِالْعُلُوْمِ الْإِلٰهِيَّةِ وَالصِّفَاتِ الرَّبَّانِيَّةِ وَالْأَخْلَاقِ الْمُحَمَّدِيَّةِ، وَقَوِّ عَقَاۤئِدَنَا بِحُسْنِ الظَّنِّ الْجَمِيْلِ وَحَقِّ الْيَقِيْنِ وَحَقِيْقَةِ التَّمْكِيْنِ، وَسَدِّدْ أَحْوَالَنَا بِالتَّوْفِيْقِ وَالسَّعَادَةِ وَحُسْنِ الْيَقِيْنِ، وَشُدَّ قَوَاعِدَنَا عَلَىٰ صِرَاطِ الْإِسْتِقَامَةِ وَقَوَاعِدِ الْعِزِّ الرَّصِيْنِ، ﴿ صِرَاطَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوْبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا الضَّآلِّيْنَ۝ صِرَاطَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ مِّنَ النَّبِيِّيْنَ وَالصِّدِّيْقِيْنَ وَالشُّهَدَاۤءِ وَالصَّالِحِيْنَ۝ ﴾ وَشَيِّدْ مَقَاصِدَنَا فِـي الْمَجْدِ الْأَثِيْلِ عَلَىٰ أَعْلَىٰ ذُرْوَةِ الْكَرَامَةِ وَعَزَاۤئِمِ اُولِـي الْعَزْمِ مِنَ الْمُرْسَلِيْنَ، يَا صَرِيْخَ الْمُسْتَصْرِخِيْنَ، يَا غِيَاثَ الْمُسْتَغِيْثِيْنَ، أَغِثْنَا بِأَلْطَافِ رَحْمَتِكَ مِنْ ضَلَالِ الْبُعْدِ، وَاشْمَلْنَا بِنَفَحَاتِ عِنَايَتِكَ فِـيْ مَصَارِعِ الْحُبِّ، وَأَسْعِفْنَا بِأَنْوَارِ هِدَايَتِكَ فِـيْ حَضَاۤئِرِ الْقُرْبِ، وَأَيِّدْنَا بِنَصْرِكَ الْعَزِيْزِ نَصْرًا عَزِيْزًا مُّؤَزَّرًۢا بِالْقُرْآنِ الْمَجِيْدِ، بِفَضْلِكَ وَرَحْمَتِكَ يَاۤ أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ ۝

Allāhumma-shghalnā bika wa hab lanā hibatan lā saʿata fīhā li-ghayrika wa lā madkhala fīhā li-siwāk — wāsiʿatan bi-l-ʿulūmi l-ilāhiyyati wa ṣ-ṣifāti r-rabbāniyyati wa l-akhlāqi l-Muḥammadiyya. Wa qawwi ʿaqāʾidanā bi-ḥusni ẓ-ẓanni l-jamīli wa ḥaqqi l-yaqīni wa ḥaqīqati t-tamkīn; wa saddid aḥwālanā bi-t-tawfīqi wa s-saʿādati wa ḥusni l-yaqīn; wa shudda qawāʿidanā ʿalā ṣirāṭi l-istiqāmati wa qawāʿidi l-ʿizzi r-raṣīn: ⟨ ṣirāṭa lladhīna anʿamta ʿalayhim ghayri l-maghḍūbi ʿalayhim wa lā ḍ-ḍāllīn; ṣirāṭa lladhīna anʿamta ʿalayhim mina n-nabiyyīna wa ṣ-ṣiddīqīna wa sh-shuhadāʾi wa ṣ-ṣāliḥīn ⟩ . Wa shayyid maqāṣidanā fī l-majdi l-athīli ʿalā aʿlā dhurwati l-karāmati wa ʿazāʾimi ulī l-ʿazmi mina l-mursalīn. Yā Ṣarīkha l-mustaṣrikhīn, yā Ghiyātha l-mustaghīthīn: aghithnā bi-alṭāfi raḥmatika min ḍalāli l-buʿd, wa-shmalnā bi-nafaḥāti ʿināyatika fī maṣāriʿi l-ḥubb, wa asʿifnā bi-anwāri hidāyatika fī ḥaḍāʾiri l-qurb, wa ayyidnā bi-naṣrika l-ʿazīzi naṣran ʿazīzan muʾazzaran bi-l-Qurʾāni l-majīd — bi-faḍlika wa raḥmatika yā Arḥama r-rāḥimīn
