O Allāh, occupy us with You, and grant us a gift in which there is no room for other than You and no entry for any besides You — a gift wide with the divine sciences, the Lordly attributes and the Muḥammadan character. Strengthen our convictions with beautiful good opinion, the truth of certainty and the reality of firm establishment; make our states sound with success, felicity and excellent certainty; and make firm our foundations upon the path of uprightness and the solid pillars of might: ⟨ the path of those You have favoured, not of those upon whom is anger, nor of those who go astray; the path of those You have favoured among the prophets, the truthful, the martyrs and the righteous ⟩ . And build our aims, in deep-rooted glory, upon the highest summit of nobility and the resolves of the messengers of firm resolve. O Answerer of those who cry out, O Rescue of those who seek rescue: rescue us by the subtleties of Your mercy from the straying of distance; enfold us in the breaths of Your solicitude in the places where love strikes down; assist us with the lights of Your guidance in the precincts of nearness; and support us with Your mighty help — a mighty help, girded with the glorious Qurʾān — by Your grace and Your mercy, O Most Merciful of those who show mercy

﴿ رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّاؕ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ السَّمِيْعُ الْعَلِيْمُ۝ وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَاۚ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيْمُ۝ ﴾ اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَىٰ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدِ النَّبِيِّ الْأُمِّيِّ وَأَزْوَاجِهٖ اُمَّهَاتِ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَذُرِّيَتِهٖ وَأَهْلِ بَيْتِهٖ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَىٰ إِبْرَاهِيْمَ وَعَلَىٰ آلِ إِبْرَاهِيْمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيْدٌ مَّجِيْدٌ، يَا عِمَادَ مَنْ لَّا عِمَادَ لَهٗ، يَا سَنَدَ مَنْ لَّا سَنَدَ لَهٗ، يَا ذُخْرَ مَنْ لَّا ذُخْرَ لَهٗ، يَا جَابِرَ كُلِّ كَسِيْرٍ، يَا صَاحِبَ كُلِّ غَرِيْبٍ، يَا مُؤْنِسَ كُلِّ وَحِيْدٍ، ﴿ لَاۤ إِلٰهَ إِلَّاۤ أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَۖ إِنِّـيْ كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِيْنَ۝ أَنْتَ وَلِيِّـيْ فِـي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِۚ تَوَفَّنِيْ مُسْلِمًا وَّأَلْحِقْنِيْ بِالصَّالِحِيْنَ ۝ وَأَصْلِحْ لِـيْ فِـيْ ذُرِّيَّتِيْۚ إِنِّـيْ تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَإِنِّـيْ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِيْنَ۝ ﴾ صَلَوَاتُ اللهِ وَمَلَاۤئِكَتِهٖ وَأَنْۢبِيَاۤئِهٖ وَرُسُلِهٖ وَجَمِيْعِ خَلْقِهٖ عَلَىٰ سَيِّدِنَا وَنَبِيِّنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَّعَلَىٰ آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ، عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَيْهِمُ السَّلَامُ وَرَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهٗ ۝

⟨ Rabbanā taqabbal minnā, innaka anta s-Samīʿu l-ʿAlīm. Wa tub ʿalaynā, innaka anta t-Tawwābu r-Raḥīm. ⟩ Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin an-nabiyyi l-ummiyyi wa azwājihi ummahāti l-muʾminīna wa dhurriyyatihi wa ahli baytihi kamā ṣallayta ʿalā Ibrāhīma wa ʿalā āli Ibrāhīm; innaka Ḥamīdun Majīd. Yā ʿImāda man lā ʿimāda lah, yā Sanada man lā sanada lah, yā Dhukhra man lā dhukhra lah, yā Jābira kulli kasīr, yā Ṣāḥiba kulli gharīb, yā Muʾnisa kulli waḥīd. ⟨ Lā ilāha illā anta subḥānaka innī kuntu mina ẓ-ẓālimīn. Anta waliyyī fī d-dunyā wa l-ākhira; tawaffanī musliman wa alḥiqnī bi-ṣ-ṣāliḥīn. Wa aṣliḥ lī fī dhurriyyatī; innī tubtu ilayka wa innī mina l-muslimīn. ⟩ Ṣalawātu llāhi wa malāʾikatihi wa anbiyāʾihi wa rusulihi wa jamīʿi khalqihi ʿalā sayyidinā wa nabiyyinā wa mawlānā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli sayyidinā Muḥammad — ʿalayhi wa ʿalayhimu s-salāmu wa raḥmatu llāhi wa barakātuh

⟨ Our Lord, accept from us; truly You are the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing. And turn to us; truly You are the Ever-Relenting, the Merciful. ⟩ O Allāh, bless and grant peace to our master Muḥammad, the unlettered Prophet, and to his wives the Mothers of the Believers, and to his descendants and the people of his house, as You blessed Ibrāhīm and the family of Ibrāhīm; truly You are Praiseworthy, Glorious. O Pillar of him who has no pillar, O Support of him who has no support, O Treasure of him who has no treasure, O Mender of everything broken, O Companion of every stranger, O Comforter of everyone alone. ⟨ There is no god but You; glory be to You, I was among the wrongdoers. You are my protector in this world and the next; take my soul in submission and join me with the righteous. And set right for me my descendants; I have turned to You in repentance, and I am among those who submit. ⟩ The blessings of Allāh, of His angels, His prophets, His messengers and all His creation be upon our master, our prophet and our patron Muḥammad, and upon the family of our master Muḥammad — upon him and upon them be peace, and the mercy of Allāh and His blessings

اَللّٰهُمَّ أَدْخِلْنَا مَعَهٗ بِشَفَاعَتِهٖ وَضَمَانِهٖ، وَرِعَايَتِهٖ مَعَ آلِهٖ وَأَصْحَابِهٖ بِدَارِكَ دَارِ السَّلَامِ، ﴿ فِـيْ مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِنْدَ مَلِيْكٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍ۝ ﴾ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ، وَأَتْحِفْنَا بِمُشَاهَدَتِهٖ بِلَطِيْفِ مُنَازَلَتِهٖ، يَا كَرِيْمُ يَا رَحِيْمُ، أَكْرِمْنَا بِالنَّظَرِ إِلَىٰ جَمَالِ سُبُحَاتِ وَجْهِكَ الْعَظِيْمِ، وَاحْفَظْنَا بِكَرَامَتِهٖ بِالتَّكْرِيْمِ وَالتَّبْجِيْلِ وَالتَّعْظِيْمِ، وَأَكْرِمْنَا بِنُزُلِهٖ ﴿ نُزُلًا مِّنْ غَفُوْرٍ رَّحِيْمٍ۝ ﴾ فِـيْ رَوْضِ رِضْوَانِ اُحِلُّ عَلَيْكُمْ رِضْوَانِـيْ فَلَا أَسْخَطُ عَلَيْكُمْ بَعْدَهٗ أَبَدًا ۝

Allāhumma adkhilnā maʿahu bi-shafāʿatihi wa ḍamānihi wa riʿāyatihi maʿa ālihi wa aṣḥābihi bi-dārika Dāri s-Salām, ⟨ fī maqʿadi ṣidqin ʿinda Malīkin Muqtadir ⟩ , yā Dhā l-jalāli wa l-ikrām. Wa atḥifnā bi-mushāhadatihi bi-laṭīfi munāzalatih, yā Karīmu yā Raḥīm. Akrimnā bi-n-naẓari ilā jamāli subuḥāti wajhika l-ʿaẓīm; wa-ḥfaẓnā bi-karāmatihi bi-t-takrīmi wa t-tabjīli wa t-taʿẓīm; wa akrimnā bi-nuzulih — ⟨ nuzulan min Ghafūrin Raḥīm ⟩ — fī rawḍi riḍwāni “uḥillu ʿalaykum riḍwānī fa-lā askhaṭu ʿalaykum baʿdahu abadā”

O Allāh, admit us with him, by his intercession, his guarantee and his care — together with his family and his Companions — into Your abode, the Abode of Peace, ⟨ in a seat of truth with a Sovereign, All-Powerful ⟩ , O Possessor of majesty and honour. And favour us with the witnessing of him through the subtlety of his descent, O Generous, O Merciful. Honour us with the gaze upon the beauty of the glories of Your mighty Face; and preserve us by his nobility, in honouring, reverence and magnifying; and honour us with his hospitality — ⟨ a hospitality from One Forgiving, Merciful ⟩ — in the garden of good pleasure of “I send down My good pleasure upon you, and I shall never be angry with you thereafter”

وَأَعْطِنَا مَفَاتِيْحَ الْغَيْبِ لِخَزَاۤئِنِ السِّرِّ الْمَكْنُوْنِ فِـيْ مَكْنُوْنِ جِنَانِ مَعَارِفِ صِفَاتِ الْمَعَانِـيْ بِأَنْوَارِ ذَاتِ: ﴿ عَلَى الْأَرَآئِكِ يَنْظُرُوْنَ ۝ وَلَهُمْ مَّا يَدَّعُوْنَ ۝ سَلَامٌ قَوْلًا مِّنْ رَّبٍّ رَّحِيْمٍ۝ ﴾ بِإِنْعِطَافِ رَأْفَةِ الرَّأْفَةِ الْمُحَمَّدِيَّةِ مِنْ عَيْنِ عِنَايَةِ ﴿ فَضْلًا مِّنْ رَّبِّكَؕ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ۝ ﴾ فِـيْ مَحَاسِنِ قُصُوْرِ ذَخَاۤئِرِ سَرَاۤئِرِ ﴿ فَلَا تَعْلَمُ نَفْسٌ مَّاۤ اُخْفِيَ لَهُمْ مِّنْ قُرَّةِ أَعْيُنٍۚ جَزَآءًۢ بِمَا كَانُوْا يَعْمَلُوْنَ۝ ﴾ فِـيْ مِنَصَّةِ مَحَاسِنِ خَوَاتِمِ ﴿ دَعْوَاهُمْ فِيْهَا سُبْحَانَكَ اللّٰهُمَّ وَتَحِيَّتُهُمْ فِيْهَا سَلَامٌ ۚ وَآخِرُ دَعْوَاهُمْ أَنِ الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ۝ ﴾

Wa aʿṭinā mafātīḥa l-ghaybi li-khazāʾini s-sirri l-maknūni fī maknūni jināni maʿārifi ṣifāti l-maʿānī bi-anwāri dhāti: ⟨ ʿalā l-arāʾiki yanẓurūn; wa lahum mā yaddaʿūn; salāmun qawlan min Rabbin Raḥīm ⟩ — bi-inʿiṭāfi raʾfati r-raʾfati l-Muḥammadiyyati min ʿayni ʿināyati ⟨ faḍlan min rabbik; dhālika huwa l-fawzu l-ʿaẓīm ⟩ — fī maḥāsini quṣūri dhakhāʾiri sarāʾiri ⟨ fa-lā taʿlamu nafsun mā ukhfiya lahum min qurrati aʿyunin jazāʾan bimā kānū yaʿmalūn ⟩ — fī minaṣṣati maḥāsini khawātimi ⟨ daʿwāhum fīhā subḥānaka llāhumma wa taḥiyyatuhum fīhā salām; wa ākhiru daʿwāhum ani l-ḥamdu li-llāhi Rabbi l-ʿālamīn ⟩

And give us the keys of the unseen to the treasuries of the hidden secret, within the hidden gardens of the sciences of the attributes of meanings, by the lights of the Essence: ⟨ upon couches they gaze; and theirs is whatever they call for; “Peace” — a word from a Merciful Lord ⟩ — by the inclining of the tenderness of Muḥammadan tenderness, from the very eye of the solicitude of ⟨ a bounty from your Lord; that is the supreme triumph ⟩ — amid the beauties of the palaces of the treasures of the innermost secrets of ⟨ no soul knows what comfort of the eyes is hidden away for them, as a recompense for what they used to do ⟩ — upon the dais of the beauties of the sealings of ⟨ their call therein is: glory be to You, O Allāh; and their greeting therein is: peace; and the last of their call is: praise be to Allāh, Lord of the worlds ⟩
al-Ṣalāt al-Kubrā — seven daily portions.
